tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng lnga pa

de bzhin gshegs pa'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /dpal karma pa na rim lnga pa ni/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa ste gong mas lung bstan pa bzhin du/ nyang 'dam phyogs kyi yul du rje gong ma gshegs pa nas brtsams te/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas 'khor mar byung zhing 'khrungs sa'i khang pa la'ang 'ja' rtag tu zug pa/ yul mi mang po la'ang chos rje rin po che phyogs der pheb pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba sogs rmi lam bzang po rmis te sngon lung bstan pa dang*/ lhas bskul pa las thams cad kyang chos rje rin po che ni nged rang gi yul 'dir 'khrungs par gdon mi za'o zer nas mgrin gcig tu sgrogs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gzhan don la mngon par bskul ba dang*/ bod yul du rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i dus kyang mkhyen nas/ kong ral gsum las nyang po'i yul myang 'dam gyi sar gdung sna nam zhang yab sngags pa gu ru rin chen yum lha mo skyid la gzigs par mdzad de lhums su zhugs par bstan/ de'i tshe yum gyi rmi lam du byang phyogs nas rgya mi chas bzang ba mang du byung*/ de'i nang nas gsum bzhi tsam rgyun du 'ongs nas gtso bo des gnas mal g.yar zer nas lus la thim zhing gzhan rnams kyis bskor ba byed pa dang*/ khang ltag gi zhing chen po zhig dung dkar gyis gang 'dug pa las thu ba gang bsdus/ che ba zhig 'bud par brtsams tshe gnyid sad/ nam mkha' la nyi zla shar ba'i 'od kyis thams cad gang ba dang*/ gser gyi me tog 'thu ba sogs rtag tu ngo mtshar 'ba' zhig rmis/ lus yang zhing bde la zas kyi sred pa med/ skabs su lhums nas yig drug dang ā li kā li dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang gsungs/ bud med du ma dang lhan cig yur ma byed pa na de ltar gsung ba thams cad kyis thos te/ gang du grags g.yas g.yon du lta zhing the tshom du gyur/ ngo tsha ba dang gzhan la mi grags pa'i phyir pha tshad du gcig pur yur ma byas pas/ gsung che bar grags pa thams cad kyis thos nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar can zer zhing phyag 'tshal khyod kyis ci thod byed mi nyan zer/

yab kyi rmi lam du'ang dkyil 'khor rab tu bkra ba'i dbus su bum pa bzang po 'dug pa la phyag mchod byas gsol ba btab pa rmis/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs brjod las 'byung ba ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di dag gi bsod nams kyi tshogs ni gzhal bar dka' bas de'i mthus sngar yab kyi lus la nad gzhi zhig yod pa'ang sangs/ sngar yo byad kyis phongs pa zhig yod pa de phyin ci dgos byung*/ gsa' phur sgom chen bzang ba zhig gis kyang rmis ltas las gsal bar mthong ste dar cog mang po btsugs nas gnas 'di 'drar sprul sku myur du 'byon no zhes bsgrags/ yon bdag mo mgon rgyal bya bas de'i steng gi nam mkhar nyi zla zung gi bar du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na chos rje rin po che bzhugs par mthong*/ yon bdag mo sangs rgyas bya bas yul der chos rje yang yang du pheb pa sogs kyi rmi lam mthong zhing yul phyogs de dag gi nad dang 'khrug pa chad de lo legs/ khyim de la rtag tu 'ja' 'od dang me tog byung bas khyim de nyid du 'khrungs par yang thams cad kyis shes/ yab la 'gran sems yod pa'i sngags pa gcig gnyis phrag dog dang zur za byed/ de ltar lhums na gnas pa'i mdzad pas skye 'gro mgu bar byas te/ shing pho byi ba'i lo zla ba drug pa'i tshe bco brgyad kyi nyi shar la bltams/ sa cung zad g.yo ba dang me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang yul khams khyab pa byung*/ 'khrungs ma thag phyag gnyis kyis zhal phyis nas phyogs su lan gsum gzigs te/ rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ nga ni karma pak+shi yin/ 'o na nga'i mngal du 'o ma brgyal lam zhes yum gyis zhus par 'o brgyal ma byung tshul gsungs/ sngags pa phrag dog byed pa de'i bud med kyi rmi lam du bud med rgyan can mang pos gzim khang la phyag bskor byed pa dang*/ khyad par rgyan shin tu bzang ba bzhis mar me thogs te bskor ba byed pa yang yang rmis pas phyin chad dad gus dang zhabs tog byas so/

/'khrungs lo la nye gnas shākya 'od kyis bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar las khrag mig glang gi lo la zhes pa snang yang khrag mig ni mig dmar gyi 'gyur khyad yin pas de ni me yos dang rab byung sbyor ba'i tshe shing byi yin pas glang ma yin la/ rje snyag phu bas/ phag gi lo la kho bo 'chi tshul ston// byi ba'i lo la myang 'dam phyogs su skye// 'brug gi lo la gzhan don byed do ces// ji skad gsung bzhin byon la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes pa tshad mar byas so// de ltar lhums na bzhugs pa nyid nas chos rje rin po che nyid sku dngos su byon par thams cad kyis yid ches shing rtsod med du bkur ba las/ bltams ma thag tu yul gyi skye bo dag gis bkur sti mtha' yas pas mchod cing bltams nas zla phyed na slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pas ja 'dren du phyis mkhan chen mgo blon par grags pa dpon po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dpon g.yog btang ste/ phye mar na bza' la sogs pa mang du phul/ yum gyi pang na bzhugs pa las dbon po la zhal 'dzum dang mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad/ dbon po'i mdzub mo la 'jus nas pang du byon mnyes par mdzad pas the tshom dang bral ba yid ches/ blo gros rgyal mtshan par sngon du spyan ras gzigs kyis chos rje byon na mjal du mi 'gro ba e yin zhes bskul ba dang*/ lam du'ang lung bstan byung zhes 'jam dbyangs grags pas bkod/ de nas ring po ma lon par slob dpon chen po nyid kyis drung gong ma'i dngul 'bum chen mo kong por bzhengs pa mtshur phur spyan 'dren pa dang lhan cig tu byon te/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig la mjal/ 'khrungs nas zla ba drug lon pa tsam yin yang ja zhal zhus pa phyag gis reg /mdun du bu ram drangs pa la bcag nas gsol/ bzhad cing mnyes par mdzad/ der dbu zhwa na bza' gser dngul gyi gsol zhal sder bzhugs stan sogs phul nas/ slob dpon gyi sgrub gnas lkog 'phrang ri khrod du gdan drangs te/

bla ma shākra 'od pa dpon g.yog sku'i rim gro par bzhag /khong rnams kyis sku rim du zla ba re la/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bskal bzang la sogs pa'i gsung sgrog /gtsug tor stong zlog /rnam 'joms tshe chog sogs ma chag par mdzad cing zla ba dgur sku mtshams dam par bcad de mjal mi rnams la gsol ras dang na bza'i byin rlabs tsam las ma gnang*/ 'di dag gi tshe stan la skyil krung brtan por bzhugs kyi gog po ye mi mdzad/ glang lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshes kyi snga dro zhig drung na yod pa rnams yengs pa'i bar la ji ltar bzhengs ma mthong ba la phar cham tshur cham mdzad nas bzhad cing 'dug pa la gog ma dgos 'byon thub pa lags sam zhus pas 'gro thub gsungs/ rnam thar shākra 'od man 'di la stag lo zer ba 'dug kyang gong gi lo ming 'chugs snang ba des lan pas 'di 'khrungs nas zla ba bdun song ba'i skabs yin/ yang khang pa'i ka sgrog gseg ma'i bar lag pa thar tsam gyi zang zing can zhig yod pa la/ sku rtsed kyis phar thal tshur thal du 'byon zhing gda' bas shākra 'od kyis de ltar ma mdzad sku bsnad 'ong zhus pas/ bla ma pa de 'dra'i thugs khral mi 'tshal nga rang bde mor 'gro 'phro yod pa gsungs*/ yang gnam g.yos nas ser ba phrum phrum byung ba la gzigs nas sdigs mdzub dang phu mdzad pas ser rkang skad cig gis yul gzhan du 'gyur te 'di lta bu lan mang du mdzad/ nyin gcig shākra 'od la slob dpon chen po bod nas 'ong yod ja 'dren la song gsung ste de ma thag phyin pas nyi zla thang du mjal/ slob dpon chen pos drung du mjal te dbus gtsang gi 'bri gdan tshal pa sogs yon bdag bu slob so so nas/ ja 'dren 'bul ba rnams phul te rtse lha sgang du byon/ drung nyid de kar bzhugs mtshur phu karma nags phu sogs phyogs 'di dang 'di na yod/ de rnams kyi tshul 'di ltar yod ces nges pa dang bcas te gsungs/

slob dpon chen po slar byon par thos pa nas bla ma yab sogs ja 'dren la song ba zhag mang du 'gor ba la da nam 'ong zhus pas/ phyag mdzub gnyis brkyang ste zhag 'di na 'ong gsungs ba de bzhin byung*/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu la drung na rim bzhi'i mtshan smos te de rnams gang na bzhugs zhus pas/ thugs kar phyag mdzub gtad de 'di na gsungs/ khyed lags sam zhus pas yin yin gsungs nas bzhad/ yon bdag theb grol la sogs pa nad kyis gzir ba du ma la byin rlabs mdzad de 'di tsam na phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa bzhin so sor byung*/ 'gro mgon gyis drung pa sngon la mtshur phu karma gang du 'byon zhus pas/ nged dang por karmar 'gro ba yin gsungs/ sgar pa nyang por byon pa yun ring du song*/ da nye bar byon nam zer nas ja 'dren la 'gro zhus pas/ 'gro ma ran gsungs/ zla phyed tsam na shākra 'od la da song dang*/ khyed la gser zhig kyang ster bar 'dug gsung ste rtsi gar du mjal zhing de bzhin du byung*/ slob dpon chen po sogs phebs nas mjal/ bzhugs pa'i khri chung zhig yod pa de mtho bar gyis gsung nas slar yang brtsigs/ thams cad la phyag 'tshol gsung zhing phyag dbang yang yang du mdzad cing bzhad/ dgung lo gsum pa'i dus su slob dpon pa la 'di ltar gsungs/ rang re gong du phyin dus/ rgyal po yum sras bcas pa la dbang bskur mdzad dus/ gser bre dngul bre la sogs pa'i 'bul ba byung tshul dang*/ gong du byon pa'i lo rgyus zhib tu gsungs ba la/ slob dpon pas drung pa rdzun mi mdzad par zhu/ rang re gong du byon ma myong zhus pas/ rdzun min/ rang re byi ba'i lo la gong du pheb/ de la sogs pa'i lo rgyus mang du gsung pas slob dpon pa mnyes par gyur to// shākra 'od la tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dra dang nga'i sba lcag khyer shog gsungs/ nged la de med zhus pas/ zho kha thang gi gzim khang na sgam gyi nang du yod do gsungs/

shākra 'od shin tu dga' nas bsod rin btang ste/ de blangs nas drung du phul lo/ /ba ru sna'i gru khar byon dus/ ma 'gro bar chad 'ong dogs yod gsungs/ sku 'khor rnams kyis gsung la ma rtsis par byon pas gru log nas chab kyis gdan drangs nas bying ba med par chu'i phar khar byon no// yos lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la khong rang gi khri'i steng du gsar du khri brtsigs te der bzhugs nas bla ma shākra 'od la gsungs pa khyod kyis nga la phyag 'tshol gsungs/ khyod la phyag mi 'tshal chos 'brel med zhus pas/ nga rdo rje 'chang yin khyod kyis nga la sngar chos zhus pa yin/ cis kyang phyag 'tshol gsungs/ de nas phyag 'tshal ba la/ yang 'tshol gsungs/ mang du 'tshal bas byin rlabs mang po mdzad/ da yang phyag 'tshal lam zhus pas/ da sdod gsungs nas mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ de nas rtogs ldan ye shes dpal ba dpon slob rnams mjal te/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag la sogs pa'i 'bul ba cher byas so/ /de'i tshe dbu zhwa blangs te mnabs so// yang nyin gcig ri ltas la 'gro gsungs nas/ gnyan mo steng du byon nas chos khri brtsigs nas de'i steng du bzhugs te/ 'tshogs pa rnams la thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas gsungs/ shes rab brtson 'grus bya ba'i sgom chen pa chos rje gong ma'i zhabs tog yun ring byas pa zhig ri khrod du sgo bcad la yod pa/ sprul sku dang e mjal bsam nas 'dun pa byas pa'i rmi lam du chos rje gong ma'i sku gzi mdangs phun sum tshogs pa dang mjal nas chos mang po gsungs/ byin rlabs mdzad pa'i rjes la thub pa'i gser sku zhig bstan nas/ nga 'di yin gsungs pas gser sku de skyes bu gzi mdangs dang ldan pa gcig tu gyur pas chos gsungs/ byin rlabs mdzad pa zhig rmis/ gnyid sad pa dang dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes te/ mtshams hur 'don byas nas byon nas mjal ba'i tshe/ drung du dang por mjal dus/

shes rab brtson 'grus 'ong bar 'dug /ces gsungs pas/ sngar gyi rmi lam gyi sku de dang sprul pa'i sku khyad med par mthong ste zhabs tog byas nas phyags phyir 'brang ngo*/ /de nas 'ob glang dkar gyi mi sde rnams kyis gdan drangs nas brgya 'bul mang po dang*/ mdzo rta mang du phul nas tshur byon pa'i lam du rlung 'tshub chen po byung ba phyag mdzub kyis bzlog go /mgyogs pa'i don du shākra 'od kyis bcibs gong du pang nas 'byon bsam kyang ma gnang de 'dra mi nyan/ ngal brnyas pa ma byed gsung nas/ khong rang gcig pur bcibs nas byon no// de nas tsā ri lkog 'phrang nags phu/ rtse lha sgang la sogs pa'i dgon sde 'dzin pa'i bla ma/ dge 'dun yon bdag rnams kyis byon zhu so so nas phul ba la/ thog mar nags phu dang nyang lung pa la zhal bzhes mdzad do/ /'brug lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshes la nags phur byon pa'i lam du/ rtogs ldan shākra 'od pa chab rom la 'dred nas rtsib ma gsum chag nas 'dug pa la/ drung pa'i phyag gis byin rlabs mdzad nas ci yang mi lto gsungs pas na ba tsam yang ma byung ngo*/ /'di dag gi skabs su chos khri brtsigs nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ dgon pa 'debs pa yin gsungs nas khang chung mang po'i gzugs mdzad cing dar cog 'dzugs pa dang*/ chu la zam pa 'dzugs pa dang*/ nga karma dang mdo khams phyogs su 'gro ba yin gsungs nas/ shing bu dang rde'u mang po bsdu zhing*/ la la mdzo rta dang*/ la la gser dngul gos dar yin gsung nas/ thum po dang*/ khres po mdzad cing*/ 'khor rnams so sor gnyer du bsko ba la sogs rten 'brel gyi ltas khyad par can mang po mdzad do/ /de nas nags phur chags pheb ste skye bo dpag tu med pas mjal nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'phel zhing*/ rim gyis brag gsum gyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis gdan drangs nas zho kha nas phyags pheb pa'i tshe/ 'phan chen la mjal nas bkur sti mchod pa dpag tu med pa byas shing*/

de nas du ma rgyang dang*/ mtsho chu phyogs kyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyis gdan drangs nas/ rta brgya 'bul la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mang po byas shing sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad do// rta bar rgyal 'dzin nas drung gong ma gnyis la rta brgya 'bul du ma byas pa'i yon bdag chen po rgan mo blo bde'i bu brgyud a dpal sogs kyis rta brgya 'bul byed pas phebs par zhu bar yong ba la gzigs ma thag yon bdag dpyal pa phyin 'dug ang gsung ste de lta bu ni bgrang gis mi lang*/ de nas sngar gyi zhal bzhes dang mthun par kong por byon pa'i lam du/ gnas gzhir phyags phab pa'i tshe/ mi rnams kyis rtogs ldan pa de ring mjal ba la 'ong zer nas 'byon pa'i chis byas/ pak+shi bsod nams bzang po la sogs pas drung du zhu ba byas/ khyad par du dge bshes shākya rdo rje bya bas/ drung pa rtogs ldan pa de ring 'byon zer ba zhes yang yang zhus pas/ drung gi zhal nas/ rtogs ldan pa de ring mi 'ong*/ sang nyi dros tsam na lam du mjal/ gsungs pa bzhin sang mjal bas/ drung gi zhal nas nga i bden par 'dug gsungs/ kho dad nas phyag 'tshal bshags pa byas/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod pas 'bul ba mang po dang sngon gyi dbu zhwa phul ba na phyag gis blangs te dbu la mnabs pa na/ dbu la yangs dog gi skyon med par 'tshams pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/

de nas se mo gnyen khrir chags phebs pa'i tshe/ drung gi zhal nas/ de ring bla ma mkhan po ba 'ong yod gsungs/ de ring e 'byon ci cha zhus pas 'ong bar yod/ mi 'di 'dra bar zhig 'ong bar yod gsung nas zhal yo ba'i tshul mdzad/ gos 'di 'dra ba zhig gon 'dug / 'bul ba 'di 'dra byed gsungs pas/ dgongs mo zhal yo ba'i tshul du byung zhing*/ gos dang 'bul ba'ang gsungs pa ltar snang ngo*/ /de ltar gang du byon pa de dag thams cad du/ kha mchu che chung rnams dang*/ ri rgya/ lam rgya/ klung rgya la sogs pa thams cad phul zhing thams cad bde legs dang ldan par mdzad do// de nas rta bar rgyal 'dzing du byon te/ yon bdag gis rta brgya 'bul dang*/ skye bo khri phrag mang po la sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i ston mo dang*/ chos gsungs pa'i tshe nam mkha' la nyi zla skar gsum shar ba dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od rab tu bkra ba dag gis gang ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can snang bas/ thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa rab tu thob par gyur to// de nas g.yang kha steng du chags phebs pa'i tshe/ chos skyong ma mgon rnams bsu ba byed dus 'di bzhin byed 'dug gsungs nas chos skyong gis 'chams pa'i tshul mdzad do/ /nyin cig gi tshe/ 'gro rnams dge ba'i phyogs la bkod pa'i phyir/ /thams cad chos kyi phyogs la btang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par nyang stod smad/ kong po la sogs yon bdag 'byor pa can gyis phul ba'i gser dngul/ mdzo rta/ gos dar la sogs pa rnams/ ma ṇi/ bskang ba/ tshe chog /rnam 'joms/ mdo sgrub la sogs pa rgyun kha mang po btsuḍa nas de rnams la byin te/ dbyar dgun skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par sku rim la 'bad do// de nas slob dpon pad+ma'i sgrub gnas bkra shis lkog 'phrang dang*/ stag khrom ri khrod du chags phebs nas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gsum gyi dgongs mo nam mkha' la gziḍa nas khyed rnams kyis e mthong gsungs/

ma mthong ci lags zhus pas/ mdzub mo nam mkha' la btsugs nas ya ki na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la sogs pa snang*/ de rnams ci 'dra 'dug zhus pas/ sku mdog dang zhal phyag rnam 'gyur 'di dang 'di 'dra ba 'dug gsung nas sku lus kyi rnam 'gyur yang mdzad do// yang nyin cig sgo phye dang*/ a ma shi a ma shi zhes yang yang gsung nas bsngo ba mdzad par snang ba la/ gsungs pa bzhin yum gshegs pa dang dus mtshungs par snang ngo*/ /nang cig nga mdangs karmar phyin gsung de ci 'dra 'dug zhus pas/ lha khang mang po 'dug /la la'i sgo nub phyogs su bstan 'dug /der dge 'dun mang po snang zhes sogs gsungs te ci lta ba bzhin no// yang nyin cig /dar cog 'di'i steng du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ /de'i steng du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /de'i steng du 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ de'i steng du phyag na rdo rje rnams mu tig gi phreng ba sbreng ba ltar snang*/ khyed rnams kyis ltos dang e mthong zhes yang yang gsungs/ dbyar zhig than pa chen po byung ba la char 'bod pa'i zhu ba byas pa'i tshe/ zan la gzugs brnyan byas te cog rtse'i steng du bzhag nas chus bran pas/ tho rangs nas zhag gsum gyi bar char chen po babs so// de nas yang bla ma pa/ karma phyogs na mi mang po 'ong yod gsungs/ zhag 'ga' song ba na bya bral ba 'ga' sleb nas karma gdan sa ba shes rab me lce 'byon yod ces skad byung*/ de nas drung gis/ khyed ja 'dren la song dang myur du mjal bar yod gsung nas shākra 'od pa dpon slob song bas 'o thang gru khar mjal lo// de nas 'brug lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga'i tshe/ stag khrom ri khrod du/ rta drel gos dar gser dngul/ ja rgun/ bu ram sogs mang du phul nas/ shes rab me lces yus che ba'i tshul/ rje gong ma gshegs nas/ bdud dang bgegs rnams kyis bstan dang bstan 'dzin la/

gnod pa byed pa 'di ma gzigs sam/ da ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rnam thar dran pas brtun pa skyed dgos so/ /zhes zhus par/ bstan la gnod pa las smon gyi mthus yin yang*/ chos kyi stobs ky-is gzhom nus zhes gsungs/ nyin cig dngul gyi spos phor zhig la gzigs rtog mdzad pa la/ slob dpon pas bzhed na drung pa khyed la 'bul bas chog zhus tsam na/ khyed kyis nga la phul mi dgos/ nga la mi chen pos phul ba yin gsung ba la/ slob dpon shin tu mnyes nas bzhad/ de nas dbus phyogs kyi sde pa rnams kyis gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba so so'i 'bul ba dang bcas pa/ mtshur phu'i gu shri bzang po rin chen/ bla ma lots+tsha ba sogs kyis khyer nas byung ba rnams drung du phul zhing*/ khyad par du rgya nag gi rgyal pos kyang*/ dbu zhwa/ chos yang gi phreng ba/ gsol zhal/ na bza' cha tshang ba dang*/ zhu yig gnang sbyin rgya chen po dang bcas pa rnams/ bla ma lots+tsha la bskur 'dug pa/ chos rje'i drung du phul zhing*/ mtshur phu gu shri/ karma si tu sogs gdan 'dren pa mang pos so so nas byon zhu drag tu phul ba'i tshe/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ nged sngon la karmar 'gro ba yin gsung pa la/ mtshur phu gu shris sngon la mtshur phur 'byon dgos/ cis kyang 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzod/ gal te ma mdzad na nga khri thog tu sdod pa yin ces zhu phod byas pas/ khyod kyis ci yang mi shes/ nged gar 'gro nga rang shes mod ces sogs kyis bka' bkyon dang phyag 'jug mdzad/ de phyin chad zhu ma nus shing zhum pa dang bcas par gyur to// yang lan cig shes rab me lces/ drung ba khyed rtsed mo 'ba' zhig mdzad pas/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i skye ba ma yin pa 'dra/ zhes zhus pas/ rol pa'i rdo rje'i skye ba nga ma yin na khyed kyis logs nas 'tshol gsungs/ tsā ri ba'i sgom chen rnams kyis/ sgom zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ gzhan du ma lta rang gi sems la ltos//

rang gis rang sems bltas pa'i tshe// mthong ba'i rnam pa ci yang med// lta bas bsgom rgyu gang yang med// he he gsung ngo*// rtogs ldan mtsho dkar bas/ rol pa'i rdo rje gshegs pa'i dus su/ la la la 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil na zhal bstan pa dang*/ la las seng ge la bcibs nas nam mkha' la byon par mthong ba la sogs pa mthong snang rnam pa mang po 'dug pa de kun da lta dran nam zhus pa la/ nga'i snying rje dang khyed rnams kyi dad pa la brten nas mthong snang byung ba de kun ngas kyang dran/ khyed kyang maṇ+ḍal phul zhing mchi ma phri li li 'dug pa de yin/ lar mthong lam thob na skad cig ma gcig la lus brgya ston nus pa yin gsungs/ yang bsod rin gyis drung pa bzhugs pa la dbang thob pa la bzhi bcu rtsa gsum la gshegs pa ci lags zhus pa la/ nga dbang ma che ba min te sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis gang la gang 'dul du lus brjes pa yin gsungs/ yon blos/ khyed karmar byon ma myong zhus pa la/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ nga sngar karmar phyin nas 'gro don byas pa dran gsungs pa la thams cad mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pa rab tu skyes par gyur to// shel ku ya na bzhugs dus/ bsod rin la pha ri'i sku dkar po de khyed rnams e mthong*/ khyed kyis mthong ba min spyan ras gzigs kyi sku yin/ ngas skad cig re re la rgyal sras rnams kyi sku gnam gyi skar ma tsam zhig mthong ba yin gsung*/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje la khyed kyi rnam thar bri dgos zhus tsam na/ nga'i gnyid thun gcig gi dag pa'i snang ba rang yang yi ger bri ma lang gsungs pa dang mthun par snang ngo*/ /de'i skor du ma nges par dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos gsan pa'ang nar mar mdzad de/ thog mar slob dpon chen po la phyag chen chos drug sbyor drug la sogs pa'i khrid lung dbang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ rtogs ldan rin po che la nag rgyal phag gsum sogs brgyud pa'i zab chos mtha' dag gsan zhing*/

thugs nyams su bzhes pas spang rtogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ de nas zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga'i mchod pa byed pa'i tshe/ stag khrom ri khrod kyi dge 'dun dang skye bo dpag tu med pa la/ rang rang gi dbang por mtshams pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad do// nyi shar sgang du chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i mgur 'bum gsungs pa'i tshe/ 'di sus mdzad zhus pa la/ mdzub mo rang gi shangs gong du gtad nas nga rang nyid yin no gsung ngo*// shes rab rgyal mtshan la khyod kyis nga la sha skam phul gsungs/ sha skam med zhus pas/ khyod la rkyal pa 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i nang du sha skam 'di dang 'di 'dra ba yod ces rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa gsungs pas kho shin tu dad de sha skam la sogs 'bul ba mang po byas so// de nas kong po'i yon bdag rnams kyis gdan drangs nas rim gyis 'gro don mdzad pa la/ chab nag tu yon bdag mkhar rgyal bya bas sred zhus pa'i tshe/ khyod la bu 'di tsam zhig yong gsung nas phyag mdzub la tshad mdzad pas/ phyis gsungs pa ltar byung bas dad pa rab tu thob bo/ /de nas sum mkhar du chos rje gong ma'i gzims khang du bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ tsā rir byon pa'i tshe sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs shing 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad do/ /drung gong ma'i rtsa ba'i slob ma dang sgar dpon yin zhing ba yo sogs kyi gzhi ba yang mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du khyams la rje dus mkhyen gyi rnam thar brgya rtsa ma'i ri mo dang*/ ba yor drung gong ma'i sku yang khong rang gis phyag bzo mdzad pa/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas la rgyab lhun grub steng du chags pheb nas khong la sngar chos rje gong mas gnang ba'i dar khang dang gser gyi pa tra phyag tu phul lo/ /nyin gcig drung na yod pa rnams la khyed rnams kyis e mthong*/ ba ri na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mang po 'dug gsungs/

nyin cig thang shing rnams la gzigs nas/ dpal ma mgon gyis nam mkha' gang nas 'dug gsungs/ yang gter ston la khyed kyi rtsar nga'i phyag mkhar dang sba lcag yod pa khyer shog gsungs/ med zhus pas/ yod khyer shog gsungs/ phyag tu phul bas/ khyed kyis sba lcag bcad 'dug aṃ gsungs pas khong shin tu dad de zhabs la gtugs so// yang nyin cig gi tshe/ khang gseb thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pas gang bar 'dug e mthong gsungs/ de nas phyi ma yul phyogs su gdan drangs nas/ zho kha na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma 'brong bu rin po ches/ mdzo rta gser dngul/ gos dar la sogs pa brgya 'bul mang po byas te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /de nas dgung lo bdun pa lcags rta zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes gcig la rtse lha sgang du/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa pheb ste/ mkhan po snyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po dang*/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan dpal sogs mkhas btsun mang po'i dbus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dharma shri bha dra ste/ chos dpal bzang po zhes gsol/ mkhan slob de gnyis las 'dul ba'i phyogs gtso bor gyur pa'i chos mang du gsan/ de nas snye bo'i gdan sa pa dang*/ yon bdag rnams kyis gdan drangs nas/ brgya 'bul mang po byas te/ khyad par bkra shis slong bya ba'i mi sdes gdan drangs pa'i srin po'i mkhar dang*/ khang mal du byon nas rtsi rdol 'dom re/ 'dom phyed/ 'dom do lhag tsam 'dug pa'i steng du/ phar tshur zhabs gnyis gar bzhag pa'i rdo la 'dom pa brdzis pa ltar zhabs rjes gsal bar dod pa thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub pas/ skya ser thams cad dad gus thun mong ma yin pa skyes par gyur to// de nas sprel lo zla ba dang po la khe mda' du bzhugs nas/ rtogs ldan ye shes dpal ba la/ rdo rje phreng ba la sogs pa'i dbang dang chos mtha' yas pa gsan no/ /'di dag gi skabs su chos gsan tshul rnams gsan yig chen mor blta'o/

/de'i tshe rtogs ldan ye shes dpal ba la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po 'dzom pa'i sar/ dge bshes bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis/ chos rje'i drung du/ sangs rgyas la sogs dkon mchog gsum/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid zhus/ chos rjes/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid ni/ skyabs gnas gang zhig don gnyis phun tshogs rab kyi mthar phyin pa/ /zhes sogs 'god cing*/ chos kyi bgro gleng mdzad pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to// de nas mdo khams su phebs kar/ kaṃ po rdo rje dpal brtsegs dang*/ karma dpal she la sogs pa'i mdo khams kyi gzhi bdag rnams bsu ba la byung gsungs/ sgrol ma dang*/ mi pham pa dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang*/ khro bo rta mgrin dang*/ spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa zhal mthong gsungs/ de'i tshe tsā ri pa dang*/ kong stod smad kyi gdan 'dren pa dang*/ karma la sogs mdo khams kyi gdan 'dren pa rnams kyis so so nas zhu ba phul/ mtshur phu gu shri sogs mtshur phu'i gdan 'dren pa snga phyir byung nas zhu ba nan cher byas kyang ma gnang bar sngar gyi zhal bzhes dang mthun par/ karma dang mdo khams phyogs su chu sprel lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga la zho kha nas bteg ste/ rim gyis khyung thang du tshul khrims dpal pa la sogs pa'i bla ma dge 'dun stong phrag mang po dang*/ skye bo khri phrag mang po la/ dbu ma sems bskyed/ chos drug /sku gsum ngo sprod/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs zab rgyas theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' yas pa gsung nas rim gyis sta shod du byon pa'i tshe/ byin rlabs zhu mi 'ga' la gzigs nas 'di rnams rkun ma yin ma gtong gsungs/ gsungs pa ltar byung ngo*/ /de nas rim gyis ri bo che pas gdan drangs nas bla ma dge 'dun rnams la rang rang gi mos pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad do/ / ngom thang du chags phebs nas/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis rten la rab gnas zhus pa'i tshe/

gser sku la me tog gi nas zug pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od la sogs pa'i ltas khyad par can snang bas skye bo thams cad mi byed pa'i dad pa rab tu thob bo// de nas bya lo zla ba dang po la/ lha steng gi ri khrod du byon nas dge 'dun pa rnams la chos drug sogs gsungs shing*/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs shing*/ 'dir dge sbyor 'phel por 'dug ces gsungs pa dang*/ de nas dpal ldan karma'i dgon du byon nas dge 'dun rnams la zab la rgya che ba'i chos mang du gsungs shing*/ de nas sku 'bum dgon du gdan drangs nas skya ser dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad do/ /de nas 'dan ske rags pas gdan drangs nas bla ma dge 'dun yon bdag mang po dang*/ khyad par sga nas a gnyan pa la sogs kyi bla dge mang po chos kyis tshim par mdzad nas/ shar kha'i gling gi dpon chen khro bo rgyal mtshan pas gdan drangs dpon chen/ khri dpon/ da ra kha che ste las ka 'dzin pa'i sde bdag rnams kyis thog drangs bon po la sogs pa'i skye bo du ma la/ bsnyen gnas la sogs pa'i sdom pa gnang zhing rang rang gi mos pa'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad nas/ go 'jo'i dpon chen 'od zer nam mkha' pas gdan drangs nas khyi lo zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la phyags pheb ste/ las rgyu 'bras kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ chos drug la sogs bskyed rdzogs du ma gsungs nas thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa rab tu thob bo/ /de nas pha ra dgon pas gdan drangs pa'i lam du/ ril ne lha khang la rab gnas zhus pa'i tshe/ thams cad kyi mthun snang du me tog gi char du ma lang long du bab cing*/ 'ja' 'od rab tu bkra ba dag gis lung pa gang ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa rab tu thob bo//

de nas 'bom du byon pa'i tshe/ lam du mi rnams kyis drung pa'i rnam thar zhig zhu zhus pa'i lan du/ skye 'chi med pa'i sems la dbang thob kyang dbang med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba bsgral slad du/ /snying rje'i dbang gis srid par nying mtshams sbyar/ /srid pa ci srid mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /nga yi rnam thar de la gyis gsungs/ yang 'bom mtsho phyug mo'i 'gram du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ char 'bod par zhu ba la drung nas/ oṃ swasti/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi lung*/ dharma shri bha dra'i gtam/ 'bom che chung tshun chad la yod pa'i lha 'dre rnams la zlo ba/ sang dgong phan chad nas char gyi chil gyis phob cig / gal te ma phab na rtsa ra byed pa yin/ yi ge'i rten ri 'khu'i ru ma gzungs 'dam dang bcas pa yod pas bkra shis par gyur cig /ces bka' bsgo mdzad pa tsam gyis char chen po babs so/ /zla ba de'i phyi ma la 'gam nyag du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ yang char ma bab ste 'bom che chung gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis char 'bod pa'i zhu ba snga dro byung ba la/ char 'bab par yod gsungs shing rten 'brel mdzad pas/ dgongs mo nas char chen po babs so/ /de nas pu 'bor stod smad kyi bla ma mang po dang*/ gnas nang gi mkhan chen pa la sogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams mjal du byung bas/ pu 'bor phyogs su 'byon par gsol ba btab kyang da gzod sleb par byed pa yin gsungs nas chos kyis tshim par mdzad do// de nas yang dpon chen pas zla sgang du gdan drangs te/ brgya 'bul mang po dang*/ bsnyen bkur du ma zhus pa la chos kyis tshim par mdzad do/ /go 'jo'i yul du cha ga pa'i dmag gis gnod pa chen po byung ba bka' shog bsgrags pas chad/ slar yang gdan sa chen po karmar phebs/ zla stod smad/ bar thang de skor phal cher zhabs kyis bcag nas/ slar mang dbus phyogs su 'byon par dgongs pa'i tshe/ drung skor du mtshur phu ba bzhugs pas/

zhu ba phul ba la brten nas/ byang lam du brgyud de/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la gdan sa chen po mtshur phur phebs/ lam du 'khod pa rnams dang*/ dbus gtsang*/ mnga' ris sogs kyi gdul bya rnams thar pa'i sa bon khyad par can gyis rgyud smin par byas/ jo bo rin po ches thog drangs pa'i rten gsum ngo mtshar can dang mjal/ chos sde phal cher zhabs kyis bcag nas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ slar yang shar phyogs kong po'i yul du byon/ tsā ri la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can dang*/ dgon pa rnams su thugs dam dang*/ thugs sbyong la brtson pa'i tshul du ma mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i chu rta la/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa rnam thos kyi ri bor gdan drangs nas/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po dang*/ las slob yon tan blo gros/ dad pa'i dge slong sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa brgyad bcu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po bzhes/ bod du dge slong gi las gral byung ba la bzang zhing mang bar grags/ so so'i phyag gi tshe bar bar du+u sa 'jal li la sku brten pa'i ngal gso mdzad dgos pa byung skad/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char byung*/ snyag phu pa chen po 'di ni nyid kyis/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ba ku lar zhal gyis bzhes/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje la chos du ma gsan zhing rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla ma yin kyang thugs dad slob ma gzhan las che ste/ lhag bsam ma'i bstod pa mdzad*/ 'di res kyang mkhan slob las chos ka mang du gsan zhing*/ khyad par yon blo ba'i drung nas blo sbyong sogs gdams pa kha yar gsan/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal las kyang phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs chen po mtha' dag sbyong ba'i tshul mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu pa lug gi lo la/ glo lam nas brgyud de pu 'bor phebs/ gnyan po khrab ri'i zhol du/ rgya ras bcib pa brgya 'bul sogs/ bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pa du ma byas nas/

spu khrang phal cher zhabs kyis bcags shing*/ der gnas pa'i sems can gyi don tshad med pa mdzad/ slar yang kong po nas lam mdzad de/ dbus phyogs su byon/ lha sar phebs jo bo rin po che la mchod pa'i sprin dpung dpag tu med pas mchod cing*/ 'gro ba mang po la chos kyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa bskor/ dbus phyogs kyi 'bri gdan dang*/ sne'u pa sogs lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis gtsug gis bkur nas kun gyis mchod pa'i zhing dam par bzung*/ 'di skor du sngar hor gyi rgyal po tho gan thi mur gyis lo so lnga rgyal sa mdzad/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje bod la phebs nas lo lnga na/ rgya'i ngo log byung bas/ gong ma hor yul la byon te/ rgya nag gi rgyal po tha'i jus rgyal sa cung zad dang*/ de nas ta'i ming rgyal po chen pos rgya hor mi nyag thams cad kyi rgyal po mdzad/ rgyal khams thams cad bde chos rje rin po che'i snyan pas thugs phrogs te spyan 'dren yang yang du btang zhing khyad par du bla ma khyed kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos zab mo mkhyen pa'i don la nub phyogs kyi sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa kun gyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ gus pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu'i/ ༈ khyed thabs shes rab yon tan phrin las mchog gi dngos grub ma thob na de bzhin du sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po ga la 'byung*/ ༈ nged sngar byang phyogs su yod pa'i dus su/ ༈ khyed kyi mtshan bzang po thos nas lan cig mjal bsams pa'i sems bzhin da lta go sa chen po la bzhugs/ yul dbus kyi rgyal khams kun bde bar 'dug /yun ring du bsam pa la mun pa bsal ba lta bu drin mnyam pa nyid phan yon thun mong du mdzad dgos/ sngar/ ༈ shākya thub pas thugs rjes bzung nas sems can thams cad kyi don byed/ ༈ thub pa'i chos kyi dngos grub zab mo thob pa'i don la/ khyed/ ༈ thub pa'i thugs dang gnyis su med par 'dug pas yul dbus 'dir byon nas/

༈ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang rgyal khams kyi phan bde la dgongs nas/ ༈ nged kyis sngar bsams pa bzhin rjes su 'brengs nas/ ༈ bla ma khyed cis kyang 'byon par mdzod/ sngar gyi rgyal pos yul dbus kyi rgyal khams bde ba'i sgo nas bcos pa yin/ ༈ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dad pa sngon du 'gro ba/ ༈ nged kyi yab/ ༈ tha'i rgyal po hu hang dang dad pa can gyi btsun mo/ ༈ hu hwang bu gnam la gshegs nas yun ring drin bsab dgos pa thabs gang yang ma rnyed/ ༈ bla ma khyed thabs shes phrin las kyi sgo nas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i don gyis/ ༈ sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid yin par 'dug /cis kyang myur bar byon nas 'das pa rnams la sgrol ba'i cho ga sgrub pa'i don la da lta'i li skyam/ sha'u skyam/ hu'u rkyen/ la sogs pa mngags nas yi ge'i rten bskur gdan 'dren song yod/ ༈ bla ma thugs rjes bzung la mnyes par mdzod la myur du 'byon pa zhu/ yi ge'i rten gyi dngul bre chen gsum la srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ gos yug mdog phyi bcu/ nang dar mdog mi 'dra ba bcu/ tsan+dan dum gcig /spos dkar rgya ma bcu/ zu 'u hang spos rgya ma gang*/ ja dkar rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu/ sna drug yun lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang chen po nas bris/ zhes pa'i lung gdan drangs pa'i gser yig pa rnams dbus su sleb/ nan tan gyis zhu ba phul ba la brten nas/ bstan 'gror phan bde'i sgor 'gyur pa mkhyen nas 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes/ dbus gtsang gi sde pa rnams nas kyang sku rdzongs/ 'bul nod skyel ma dang bcas pa legs par byas/ dgung lo nyer gnyis shing mo bya'i lo la dbus nas bteg ste/ byang ngos su brgyud nas ston sog tu phebs/ dgun bzhugs nags shod du mdzad/ de nas sos chen mo nas lam sgom sde nas brgyud de/ me khyi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum la lha steng du phebs/

tshes brgyad la gdan sa chen po karmar phebs/ zhag bcur bzhugs shing*/ slar yang lam du mi 'gor ba'i zhu ba yang bskyar 'bul ba dang*/ karma'i dgon gsos 'bul ba dang bcas par rgya'i tā zhing mi chen rnams sleb pas mjal/ de nas myur stabs su tshes bco brgyad la sga ra pa ke stod du bteg /ke rags rgyang du zhag nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam bzhugs nas bdag po chen po kān ting go shri ba dang*/ cha bu tho ba smad khams kyi dgon sde thams cad kyi gdan sa rnam pas mgo byas/ dge 'dun phal che ba dang*/ bla ma shing mgo pa dpon slob rnams dang*/ shang kha'i grwa pa rnams kyis 'bul ba bzang po phul/ de dag chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ karma si tu pa dang lha steng dbon po rnams kyis ke nang bar chibs skyel zhus/ de nas 'bri chu bar tshugs drug gnang*/ klong thang gi gru bton/ 'danā gru thang du phyin gling tshang gis 'bul ba mang du byas/ de nas ra rgya gru+u sa bar du tshugs bcu/ de nas khrom phu rong bar du tshugs bcu drug gnang*/ khrom bu rnams kyis rta lnga brgya tsam phul/ de nas tshugs gcig par ta zhing sleb/ de nas tshugs gnyis bteg nas ga chur phebs/ de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la ga chu nas bteg pas 'jam tshugs gsum nyi ma gnyis la sh-ing kun du phebs/ de nas tshugs gnyis pa nas chu ma mkhar du phebs/ de nas 'jam tshugs bcu dgu song nas zam shing rgyal bu dang mjal/ de nas 'jam tshugs nyi shu song nas paṇa glang rgyal bu dang mjal/ des bsu ba dang 'bul ba zhabs tog gya nom pa byas/ de nas 'jam tshugs bcu bzhi song nas hung mang du dge 'dun pa mang pos bkur sti 'bul ba byas/ de nas 'jam tshugs gsum gyi bar chu bun pho brang gi rgyal bu gnyis 'bul ba la sleb/ de nas 'jam tshugs gsum song nas/ pho brang mdun du chu chen snang ba la sa le bar nyi shu'i tshod la/ gru nang du phebs/ gru kha de na shan stong phrag gsum tsam 'dug

/chu phar kha na rgyal chas sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i glang po che sum cu tsam la rgyan du mas mdzes par byas shing*/ dge 'dun pa khri tsho tsam gyis bsu ba byas/ nam mkha' dwangs ba'i nang nas 'ja' tshon byung ba kun gyis mthong*/ tshes grangs kyang me mo phag gi lo zla ba dang po'i nyi shu gcig yin/ de nyin 7gong ma pho brang nas phyi'i lcags ri'i nang du byon nas/ drung du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsib stong yod pa zhig phul/ ja zhal 7gong ma rang bzhengs nas mdzad cing*/ dpon slob kun la chab tsha gnang*/ mchod yon mjal ba'i yi ger 'di tsam snang la/ da lta gsung rgyun la 7gong mas mngon mkhyen yod na mjal dar gcig pa bsnams yong dgongs nas phyag shub kyi nang du dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bcug nas thog mar phul/ chos rjes kyang mkhyen te de ma thag sku phrag nas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bton nas gnang bas thugs lhag par dad/ phyis gnyis kar gser gshog re sbran nas phul ba da lta gan+dho la'i mchod rdzas kyi g.yas 'khyil mkhyid gang tsam pa gnyis po 'di yin gsungs/ mngal khang sar du byas par de nub bzhugs/ sang tho rangs nas phyag phyi ba thams cad la/ gos bzhi bzhi re/ l+h+wam re/ mi grags pa rnams la zhwa theb re gnang*/ gong ma phug nas tshur bzhugs/ rgya'i lugs g.yon che bar byed pas/ drung g.yon nas tshur bzhuḍa/ gzhan rnams mdun g.yon g.yas su bzhugs te bkur sti mdzad/ de nas gong ma pho brang du byon/ dpon slob rnams mjal khang du bzhugs/ nyi shu+u gnyis kyi phyi nang snga mo nas pho brang du byon te bsu ba la rgyan chas mtha' yas pa can gyis lag na gos dar gyi khang bzang dang*/ gser g.yu'i khang bzang dang*/ gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phan ba dan phur ma la sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ glang po che dkar po gcig gzhan gnyis dang gsum la gser gyis theg tshad kyis spras pa dang*/ gzhan glang po che sum brgya tsam la rgyan chas sna tshogs bkal ba dang*/

dge 'dun snam sbyar can khri tsho lnga tsam gyis lag tu me tog dang*/ rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa bzung ba dang*/ rgyal bu chen po dgu ta'i zhing stong tsho gsum gyi mgo byas/ las ka can gyi mi chen 'bum tsho gcig la/ dmag mi 'bum tsho bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i la las khrab gyon la las phub khur phal cher gyis mdung bzung ba dang*/ gser gyi tho ba s+t+wa gri yob chen rtse gsum ral gri sogs re re'ang bzung ba brgya re dang*/ gser dngul gos dar las byas pa'i nyi zla'i gzugs bzung ba bzhi stong tsam 'dug/ de nas pho brang gi sgor gong ma chen po nyid bsu ba la byon/ phyi na bsu ba'i bkod pa ci 'dug nang na yang 'dug cing*/ khyad par gser gyi khrab rmog kho na gyon pa nyis brgya tsam 'dug /mjal 'dzom gyi khang pa de'i sgo lhor lta ba rim pa lnga'i nang ma gser 'ba' zhig las byas pa/ gser thog gser ka can bod kyi ka ba so gnyis kyi mal la phyogs bzhi kar sgo sum ral re 'dug /mchod yon bzhugs lugs sngar ltar mdzad/ drung gi ma tshad du bla ma rnam gsum/ grwa pa rnams g.yon phyogs su bzhag /sgo bzhir gser khrab gyon pa lnga bcu re/ gong ma'i g.yas g.yon du phub khur mda' gzhu btags pa bzhi bcu tsam re 'dug / zas sna mtha' yas pa'i gung tshigs gnang*/ de nas gong ma'i mdun du rtse sna rnams mus kyis yong 'dug/ 'byon dus gong ma mchod yon sgo dbus ma la byon nged rnams g.yon la 'gro ba bcol/ gong mas pho brang gi sgo'i bar du bskyal/ sngar gyi bsu ba rnams kyis dgon gyi bar bskyal/ sgir hor dus nas pho brang na kar sde mang du+u yod mod kyang*/ khyad par du rgya lugs kyi bkod pa can gyi lcags ri phyir ling gu si'i sde dang*/ nang du tā tu kar sde sar du btab pa la bzhugs gnas mdzad/ 'di gnyis rtse lnga'i kar sde rnams la bla ma'i bsko bzhag sgar nas phyi mo'i bar mdzad bzhin du yod 'dug cing*/

gtsug lag khang bla brang dang bcas pa'i deb rtse lha sgang na 'dug pa yang bdag gis mthong*/ phyi nyin nyi shar tsam du gong ma dgon du tshur byon/ drung nyid kyis gzim khang gi nang sgo dang*/ bla ma rnams kyis bar sgo nas bsus/ 'bul ba la rta dkar po gsum la chib sga btod pa/ gzhan rta dkar po bco brgyad/ 'di la rgya nag na rta dkar po mchog tu byed pa/ sngon po rgas pa'i dkar po min par thog ma nas dkar po yin/ gser bre bdun/ dngul bre sum cu rtsa bdun/ gos yug brgya lhag /ja par sig sum cu/ gser gyi rdor dril bco lnga/ gser gyi bum pa gnyis/ dngul gyis bum pa lnga/ gser dngul gyi ting mañdzir cha/ gser dngul gyi pad sder lnga re/ gzhan yang mchod cha srid tshad/ gser dngul gyi gsol zhal sder dpag med phul ba gan+dho la'i 'bul ba yin pa'i lung byung*/ nyi shu gsum gyi nang par yin/ nyer bzhi la bla ma rnam gsum gyi mgo byas pa'i phyag phyi ba rnams pho brang du shog gsungs te/ pho brang gi khyams su mjal kha btang*/ phyag re re las mi dgos pa'i lung byung*/ 'brong bu go shri pa/ slob dpon bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal/ mkhan chen mgon blon pa ste bla ma rnam gsum la/ dngul bre phyed gsum pa re/ gser gyi mchod cha rgyas pa re/ phyar dar re/ gtor cha re/ gos sbyar re/ gsol zhal sder re/ gos phyi nang bcu gnyis re/ cha 'u gnyis stong re/ rdor dril cha bzhi re/ phreng dkar re rnams gnang*/ grwa pa spyi la rab rnams la dngul bre chen re/ cha'u brgyad brgya re/ gos yug drug re/ dar yug drug re gnang*/ 'bring rnams la dngul bre sum gnyis re/ gos dar yug drug re/ cha'u bzhi brgya re/ tha ma rnams la dngul bre phyed re/ gos dar yug bzhi re/ cha'u sum brgya re/ thams cad la phreng dkar re/ gos sbyor re/ rdor dril cha gnyis re

gnang*/ nyer bdun gyi nang par gong ma drung gi gzim khang du byon te/ tsan+dan dkar po las bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong brkyang khru do yod pa zhig dang de'i mchod cha dngul kong sogs dngul spyad dang*/ shel gyi mchod cha mtha' yas pa phul/ de nas zla ba phyi ma'i yar tshes gcig la lo sar byas pa la/ 'di ltar na rgya'i lugs kyi lo snga ma la zla ba shol byung bar mngon/ drung nas dbu mdzad dpon slob thams cad tho rangs nas pho brang gi shar sgo nas yar byon nas khyams zhig tu bzhugs/ gong ma der drung du byon nas ja zhal mdzad/ nam dngas pa dang pho brang gi phyogs bzhi ka nas khyams kyi dben chen po yod pa'i nang du gong ma la/ las ka can gyi mi chen 'bum phrag lnga tsam gyis phyag 'bul 'dug /stag gnyis/ bse lnga/ g.yi dkar gnyis/ glang po che brgya tsam dang lag cha sngar bsu ba la byung ba rnams re re'ang stong stong 'dug /mdung bzung khrab gyon pa 'bum tsho re re 'dug /gar pa gnyis brgya tsam gyis mgo byas/ rtsed sna mi gcig pa stong tsam 'dug /de rnams la mchod yon gyis yud tsam gzigs nas pho brang du byon te sngar ltar bzhugs ston mo bzang po gnang*/ de phyir grwa pa rnams kyis phyag mi dgos pa'i lung byung*/ rtsed mo pa thams cad rim pa ltar mchod yon gyi mdun du 'ong bcug nas rtsed mo dang glu gar rol mo rnams byed cing rim pas phyir song*/ dgongs mo phyir byon pa la gong mas sgo gsum bar du bskyal/ rgyal bu rnams kyis dgon par bskyal/ gong mas mi chen de thams cad la ston mo gnang*/ yang bco lnga'i nang par dpon slob nyi shu spyan drangs te/ rtsed mo son mo sngar bzhin 'dug /de nub pho brang gi khyams chen po der me'i me tog dang*/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs me rtsed kyi rigs mang po dang*/ rtsed mo'i rigs 'bum phrag tsam 'dus pa la gzigs/ srod tsam na dgon par phebs/

gzim khang gi sgor yang de dang 'dra ba'i mchod pa dang rtsed sna sna tshogs pa 'dug /de nas nyi ma thams cad la gong ma la chos rim par gsungs/ nyi shu lnga la dpon slob thams cad pho brang du spyan drangs/ shar sgo nas gser khang du dang por byon/ de nas sngar gyi mjal phrad byas sar byon spyan gzigs drangs/ drung du dngul srang stong la dngul bre lnga byas pa dang 'bul ba mang du mdzad/ rtsed mo dang sngar gyi rnams phal cher 'dug /khyad par spre nag rkang thang dang spre dkar rta zhon sogs 'dug pa la nub sgo nas gzigs mo mdzad/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes lnga nas dky-il 'khor gyi nang rnams kyi thig btab pa la/ drung gis rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rin po ches phur pa/ bka' bzhi pas gsang 'dus/ dbon po pas mi tra/ gzhan rnams kyis rdor dbyings/ chos dbyings gsung dbang*/ dgyes rdor/ rje btsun ma/ kun rig /sman bla/ sgrol chog /thugs rje chen po'i gzungs sgrub sogs/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bzhengs/ dbu 'dzugs la gong ma byon nas/ drung du rnam gsum tshang ma'i 'bul ba dang*/ bla ma rnams la gos phyi nang bzhi re/ gzhan dkyil 'khor re la gos phyi nang re/ gong ma'i phyag gis blangs nas gnang*/ tshes bco brgyad kyi bar du cho ga mdzad pa la/ nyin gcig bzhin gong ma yab yum byon pa la/ drung gi dbang bskur re mdzad/ gzhan rnams kyis sgrol chog mdzad/ tshes bcu bzhi la 'ja'i gur phub/ gong ma mchod yon gyi gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal gzigs shing*/ rgya'i mi dpon gsum gyis kyang mthong*/ shing sdong po gcig gi mgo la bdud rtsi bab/ shug pa gcig gi mgo la gser gyi me tog skyes/ spyir cho ga'i dbu tshugs nas mthon gyi bar du 'ja' 'od sna tshogs 'khrug pa dang*/ me tog gi char nyin gcig bzhin bab pa skye bo thams cad kyis mthong ngo*// bcu dgu'i mtshan mo gong ma'i yum gyi mtshan byang drung gis bzhu/ gzhan rnams kyis rdul tshon rgya mtshor skyel ba'i tshe/

glang po che la rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bskyal/ slar drung gis gong ma la bkra shis brjod/ drung du 'bul ba la gser bre dgu dngul bre bco brgyad la sogs pa rgya cher phul/ bla ma rnam gsum la gos phyi nang cha dgu re/ dngul bre chen gsum re/ cha 'u stong re/ rta gsum re/ dar khang la gos yug brgyad re/ dar yug lnga bcu re/ grwa pa rnams la dngul srang bcu gsum re/ gos yug bzhi re/ cha'u phyed dang bzhi brgya re gnang*/ chos dbyings pa dang rdor dbyings pa gnyis la dar yug bzhi bcu re/ sman bla ba sogs la dar yug lnga bcu re/ grwa pa spyi la gos yug gsum re/ dngul srang bcu re/ cha'u brgya re gnang*/ yang tshes nyi shu nas pho brang du spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas tshe dpag med kyi dbang gong ma la mdzad/ zla ba phyi ma'i yar tshes brgyad la chos drug gi khṛd dbu btsugs nas gong mas nyams len mdzad/ phyag dpe bsgyur nas phul/ zla ba de'i nang du/ drung nyid la/ gzhu'u la'i tā' ba'u hwā wang gsi th+yan tā shan tsi tsa'i hwu ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che chos kyi rgyal po nub phyogs kyi byams pa chen po zhi ba dbang phyug gi sangs rgyas/ zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ gser srang brgya las brdungs pa'i 'ja' sa dang*/ shel gyi phyag tham yid bzhin nor bu phul/ bla ma rnam gsum la go'i shri chen po'i las ka gser gyi tham ka shel gyi tho shu gnang*/ rgya ban sum stong tsam gyis nyes pa byas pa'i don la btson du bzung nas shi ba'i nyen 'dug pa zhal ta mdzad de srog bskyabs/ gzhan yang snga rting du rgyal khams chen por yod pa'i nag can btson du gang yod la nan cher zhal ta mdzad pa'i don du snga rting gsum du yangs pa'i lung shes byed ban bon zin shing sogs chos lugs so so thams cad rang rang gi lugs tshul bzhin du gyis/ gnam mchod 'di thams cad la sus kyang gtser ba ma byed/

byas na so so'i rgan pas nged la 'phral du gtugs khrims lugs ji ltar byed pa nged kyis shes ces sogs bstan pa shed skyed kyi lung 'jā' sa rgyal khams thams cad du gnang*/ phag gru pa la dbang gi las ka dang*/ gser gyi tham ga sngon du song*/ gleng dang go 'gyo la dbang gi las ka dang tham ga gnang*/ zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du drung gi rtse lngar dbyar bzhugs mdzad de/ de nas gong ma yab sras kyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram bar skyel ma mdzad de/ slar bod du byon no zhes mchod yon mjal ba'i yi ge na 'di tsam las ma bris snang la/ spyir tha'i ju rgyal po bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa des ta'i zhing chen po mngags nas dang por birba pa spyan drangs/ ding phon bzang po chung tshad dbu chings dang*/ sham thabs chung ngur phul/ de nas gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs la ding phon che ba bla gos dang mthang gos su phul/ phyis rje de bzhin gshegs pa spyan 'dren par bzhed kyang sku gshegs pas de'i sras ta'i ming yun lo chen pos yab yum gyi thugs dgongs rdzogs dgos par yang dgongs/ khyad par rgyal po 'di 'jam dpal gyi sku'i bkod pa yin yang*/ lhag par btsun mo dam pa sgrol ma'i sprul pa des dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya ba byas pa ste/ rgyal po'i bgyi ba chen pos g.yengs/ dam pa'i chos las re zhig g.yel bar gyur tshe/ mnal lam du po ṭa lar spyan ras gzigs mjal du 'gro bar brtsams nas ri la 'dzegs pas ngal ste ldog par 'dod tshe ut+pal sngon po che zhing mtho ba rgyas pa zhig 'dug pa la bzang po'i stabs kyis ngal bsos nas/ slar phyin pa na ri rtser thugs rje chen po dang mjal byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba byung*/ de nas btsun mo dam pa des dam pa'i chos la bskul/ chos kyi rje spyan 'dren pa yang mnyel bsos pas/ gong mas kyang nga'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni btsun mo 'di yin zhes rtag tu bsngags pa mdzad skad/

gong ma chen po dang mchod yon mjal phrad kyi skabs nas brtsams te gsung chog gnang ba sogs kyi skabs thams cad du nyin re bzhin ngo mtshar gyi snang ba du ma byung ba rnams/ gong ma nyid kyi bkas nyin so so'i le'u tshe bkod par ri mo mkhan mkhas pas gzugs brnyan ri mor bris nas/ rgya hor bod yu gur tu ruṣ+ka ste yig rigs lnga lnga'i kha byang btab pa'i si thang yug dril du ma byas te/ rje'i drung nyid du phul ba deng sang phal cher 'thor yang yug dril gcig sgar chen du bzhugs pa'i nang du 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ༈¿¿ta'i ming rgyal pos/ gzhu'u la'i ta'i ba'u hwa wang ta'i shan tsi tsa'i hu'o/ /karma pa gdan 'dren gyi rgyal khams kyi ban de thams cad kyi gtso bo mdzad nas ling gu swi sde nas/ cho ga chen po mdzad/ yab tha'i dzu rgyal po chen po/ byams pa'i yum btsun mo/ 'jig rten gyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba ngan song las sgrol ba'i don la/ yun lo lnga pa zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin cho ga dbu btsugs pa la/ zhag dang po la/ sprin 'ja' kha dog sna lnga bltas na mdzes pa/ spro bsdu'i rnam pa sna tshogs yid bzhin nor bu'i 'od dang 'dra ba byung*/ yang ring bsrel mchod rten gyi steng du 'od zer 'phro ba zla ba nya gang ba dang 'dra zhing*/ dri ma med pa cung zad g.yo ba byung*/ yang gser gyi 'od zer rim pa gnyis shar/ tshes drug gi nyin/ 'ja' sprin lhung bzed kyi rnam pa lta bu nam mkha' gang ba byung*/ yang lho nub phyogs kyi sprin steng du gnas brtan gyi sku mang po byon/ re re la'ang 'khor mang po rjes su 'brang ba/ la la ni shin tu gsal ba'i rnam pa/ la la ni cung zad mi gsal ba byung nas/ re zhig bar la me tog bab nas/ la la gad/ la la ma gad pa/ yu ba rting pa thams cad shel dkar po 'dra ba/ steng 'og thams cad la 'phur ba byung*/ yang de'i rjes su 'ja' kha dog lnga/ de bzhin gshegs pas mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha khang steng du shar/

de nas re zhig tsam na sprin gyi nang na gnas brtan bcu lhag tsam lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil bsnams pa/ la la zhwa gon pa/ lag na rnga yab 'dzin pa/ sprin gyi nang na 'gro 'ong mdzad pa byung*/ ༈¿¿tshes bdun gyi nyin/ nam mkha' la bdud rtsi kha dog mar dkar lta bu/ dri zhim pa ro mngar ba bab/ yang re shig tsam na/ kha dog sna tshoḍa pa'i sprin gyi nang du/ gser gyi sdong po lta bu'i yal ga la me tog shel lta bu 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa shin tu gsal ba byung*/ ༈¿¿tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ kha dog lnga'i 'od zer lho nub kyi mtshams nas byang shar mtshams su sleb pa me tog nam mkha' la 'phur nas gar byed/ phyogs kun tu bdud rtsi bab/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che'i gnam khang steng du/ 'od zer kha dog lnga shar/ bar snang la steng du song*/ ༈¿¿tshes dgu'i nyin yang*/ lha'i me tog dang*/ bdud rtsi bab/ yang nam mkha' bar snang la bla bres dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ 'phan la sogs pa du ma snang ba yang 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnam khang steng nas/ shar nas nam mkha' la song*/ ༈¿¿tshes bcu'i nyin/ bdud rtsi'i char bab/ dri zhim pa ro mngar ba/ sbrang rtsi dang 'dra/ yang 'od zer kha dog lnga nam mkha' la thad sor steng du song*/ mchod rten gyi steng du/ ring bsrel gsum shar ba la zla ba'i 'od kyis rin po che la 'phros pa lta bu/ dper na/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rgya mtsho'i rlabs la 'phros pa dang 'dra/ 'od kyi gong bu de gsum mchod rten gyi steng dang 'og tu g.yo zhing 'khor ba 'od zer 'phro bas phyogs bcu kun tu khyab cing*/ yang dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pa nam mkha' la byon pa mi mang pos mthong ba'i rjes la/ ban de bcu lhag tsam mgo la 'bog char khur/ lag na 'khar gsil bzung nas/ srang la 'gro ba mthong*/ mi rnams kyis dris pa/ nged ling gu sī sde la 'gro zer 'gro zer/ srang gi mis mthong ba/ smin ma ring ba/

dpral ba yangs pa/ shin tu mdzes pa/ the tshom skyes te ci 'dra yin brtag pa'i ched du phyi nas 'brangs nas song*/ ling gu swi sgo mo cher sleb pa dang gar song ma mthong*/ bcu gcig gi nyin/ sprin 'ja' kha dog sna lnga shar zhing*/ lha'i me tog kyang 'khor nas bab/ bdud rtsi yang bab/ shug pa'i sdong po la gser gyi me tog pad ma 'dab stong 'dra bar 'brel pa/ rang bzhin gyis shin tu mdzes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phros/ bcu gnyis nyin/ lha'i me tog che chung dong tse tsam lha khang gi steng na nam mkha' gang ba khyab cing 'khor nas bab/ de'i nub mo lha'i dbu'i steng na 'od zer dmar po 'ja' ltar 'brel pa/ shin tu gsal zhing kun tu khyab pa/ yang 'od zer kha dog lnga/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar ba/ mchod rten gyi steng na ring bsrel rdog po gcig /nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba steng 'og kun tu 'phro zhing*/ rtswa shing thams cad de'i 'od kyis gsal ba byung*/ re zhig na yang de 'dra ba gsal ba byung*/ bcu gsum gyi nyin/ shes rab kyi 'od zer gnyis byung*/ gcig bang so la zug / gcig pho brang la zug /yang 'od dkar sna lnga yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha khang la 'khor ba/ yang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang la shar ba dang dus mnyam du me tog gi char yang bab cing*/ gong ma'i gzim ther la bskor nas bab/ nyi ma dros ka la dge ltas kyi kha ba byung*/ de'i nub mo rin po che'i 'od mchod rten khang pa'i steng du 'phros pa'i 'od kyi nang na mchod rten gyi gzugs shin tu gsal ba zhig byung*/ ban+de rkang rjen pa/ skye gzugs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba/ ben po hrul po gon pa/ lag pa g.yon pa ben bo'i thu ba bzung ba/ g.yas pas l+h+wam bzung ba/ 'gro na 'phur ba dang 'dra/ ci 'dra yin brtag pa'i ched du phyi bzhin 'brangs nas bltas kyang lha khang gi mdun du sleb pa dang*/

gar song ma shes gar btsal kyang ma rnyed/ re zhig tsam la sprin gyi nang na bzhugs pa mthong*/ bcu bzhi'i nyin/ khyung sngon po dang*/ bas ho 'o nam mkha' la 'phur nas 'khor gyin gar byed/ kha dog sna lnga'i sprin 'ja' nyi ma la bskor ba/ re zhig tsam na/ yang sprin 'ja' gyes shing 'khor gyin lha khang la bskor ba/ sprul pa mi gcig pa/ yang 'od kor/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang la bskor ba/ yang re zhig tsam na/ gser gyi 'od zer zhig shar nas thad sor nam mkha' la song*/ yang 'od zer dmar po zhig 'phros nas yun ring bar la ma yal/ de'i nub mo yang 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i nang na dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa shar/ yang byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs brnyan bcu lhag tsam shar nub la 'gro 'ong byed pa mthong*/ 'phan shing bzhi'i rtse la gser gyi 'od shar/ ༈¿¿bco lnga'i nyin/ kha dog sna lnga'i 'od zer de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha khang steng du shar/ yang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang steng du yang shar/ re zhig tsam na/ me tog pad+ma bzhin du dum bu dum bu shin tu gsal ba byung*/ yun ring zhig lon pa dang*/ yang 'od zer sna lnga 'gyur zhing shar yang*/ bkra shis kyi sprin gyi nang du drang srong gser mdog can zhig kyang*/ bas ho 'o nam mkha' la 'phur zhing 'khor nas gar byed/ re zhig tsam na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang steng na/ 'od zer dkar po zhig shar nas/ shar phyogs su song*/ de'i nub mo mchod rten dang lha khang steng du/ rgyal chen gyi khang pa'i steng du thams cad la 'ja' 'od shar/ yang 'od kor gnyis gcig la gcig 'phros pa byung*/

༈¿¿bcu drug gi nyin/ mchod rten gyi lha khang dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang dang gnyis kyi steng du 'od zer kha dog sna lnga shar/ yang sprin 'ja' shar/ lha'i me tog nam mkha' gang ba bab/ bang so dang pho brang nang gang ba bab/ ༈ bcu bdun gyi nyin/ rin po che'i mchod rten gyi steng du 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dpag med 'phros nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha khang steng tshun chad du khyab par byung*/ de'i nub mo 'phan shing gi steng du mi gnyis langs pa mthong pa'i rjes la yang*/ lho nub na/ bkra shis pa'i sprin 'ja' mang po byung ba'i steng na/ ban+de gnyis langs te/ gus pas thal mo sbyar ba mthong*/ yang sprin chung ba zhig gi steng na/ ban+de zhig thal mo sbyar nas gnyis po'i rjes su song ba mthong*/ thams cad lha khang gi phyogs su 'ongs te/ mar bab nas phyir yal song*/ skad cig la ma mthong*/ yang lho nub kyi mtshams su 'od zer kha dog sna lnga gsum byung nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha khang gi steng du byang shar nas song*/ yang 'od zer dkar po zhig shar gyi thad sor shar/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i rin po che gnam khang gi steng du/ yang 'odazer kha dog sna lnga shar/ bco brgyad cho ga rdzogs pa'i nyin/ khyung sngon po/ bas ho 'o tshan pa tshan pa 'phur nas gar byed pa dang*/ me tog gi char bab pa byung*/ phyogs thams cad nas/ sprin 'ja' kha dog sna tshogs pa/ dge ltas kyi rten 'brel mang po mu tig gi rdog po lta bu'i bdud rtsi mang po bab/ rten 'brel bzang po'i rlung*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha dpag med 'tshogs pa mang po mthong ba rnams byung*/ sprin 'ja' 'brug 'dra ba/ khyung 'dra ba/ seng ge 'dra ba/ glang po che 'dra ba/ rin po che mchod rten 'dra ba/ de'i nub mo sgo'i phyi logs na yod pa'i 'phan shing ring po'i steng na/ lha'i mar me gnyis shin tu dmar ba/ 'od gzhan dang mi 'dra ba phyogs bcur gsal ba'i nang na/

seng ge sngon po dang*/ glang po che dkar po la bcibs pa'i lha rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa 'od kyi bar snang thag ring por bltas pa'i gsal ba mthong*/ de nas re zhig na mchod rten gyi steng du ring bsrel lta bu'i 'od kyi gong bu shin tu gsal ba shar ba byung*/ lha'i mar me dang 'dres/ slar yang 'od chen por gyur/ lha'i rol mo sgra snyan sna tshogs pa khang pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi g.yo ba tsam byung*/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du yod pa rnams kyis nyan pas sgra de yang nam mkha' la yod pa tshor/ bar snang la yun ring du byung ba sogs/ yun ring po ma lon par/ dkyil 'khor thams cad gser gyi zhing khams su 'gyur ro// zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin/ bstod cing mtshan gsol ba/ gzhu'u la'i ta'i ba'u hwa wang ze then ta'i shan tsi tsa'i hu'o/ /de'i nyin par 'jig rten gyi ban+de khri tsho gnyis lhag tsam la dro drangs/ ling gu sde nas 'ja' 'od zer kha dog sna lnga nub phyogs su byung nas/ shar phyogs su sleb/ 'od zer zam pa dang 'dra/ ring ba gnam dang 'dra/ yang kha dog lnga'i sprin 'ja' shar/ 'od rab tu gsal ba sprul pa rigs mi 'dra ba 'gul ba lha'i me tog rim pa bab/ yang sprin dmar gyi 'ja' 'od mchod rten bkab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang bkab/ gnam khang gi steng na 'od zer kha dog sna lnga rim pa gsum shar gzhug na 'od zer dkar po zhig shar/ gser gyi 'od rim pa gsum shar/ tshes bzhi'i nyin/ de bzhin gshegs pa pho brang na byon nas/ skyel jin la de'i nyin par/ 'ja' 'od sngon po dkar po rim pa lnga shar/ yang 'od zer kha dog lnga de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnam khang g.yogs/ rin po che'i gnam khang steng na/ 'od zer dkar po gnyis shar/ yang 'od zer kha dog lnga/ mchod rten gyi lha khang la 'phros/ yang bas ho 'o gnyis steng na 'phur gyin gar byed/ tshes lnga'i nyin/

gong ma'i rgyal bcas ling gu sde la dro 'dren pa 'gro ba dang*/ de'i nyin par 'od zer sna lnga shar/ yang sprin 'ja' kha dog sna lnga'i 'od zer shar/ gser gyi 'od zer shar/ nyi ma'i 'og na 'phros pa shin tu gsal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang steng na 'od zer lnga shar/ yang gser gyi 'od shar/ de'i nub mo 'od zer dmar po lho phyogs su shar/ lha khang la 'phros pa shin tu gsal ba/ bcu gsum gyi nyin/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ ri bo rtse lnga la 'jam dbyangs kyi gnas bskor ba 'byon pa'i nyin/ ling gu sde nas bzhengs pa'i dus su 'od zer sna lnga/ nub byang nas shar/ yang 'od zer dmar po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang steng du shar/ mchod rten gyi rtse mo na gser gyi kha dog lta bu 'od zer zhig shar ba/ yang lha khang steng du 'od zer kha dog sna lnga rim pa gsum shar/ bco lnga'i nyin/ ban+de thams cad bka' 'gyur gyi chos 'don pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la smon lam 'debs pa dang*/ de'i nyin sprin 'ja' kha dog lnga shar/ yang nam mkha' gang ba me tog bab/ yang bas ho bo gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur gin gar byed pa/ rin po che'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs shar/ de'i nub mo bar snang na rol mo'i sgra phar 'phros tshur 'phros byung nas yun ring por lon pa dang med par gyur/ bcu drug gi nyin/ nub phyogs kyi mchod khang nang na mchod rten gyi gzugs brnyan che chung gnyis shar/ che ba la thog rim pa lnga/ gan ji ra'i rtse mo'i bar la 'dom pa do/ /chag shing gang*/ mchod rten gzugs brnyan chung ba la thog rim pa lnga/ mtho ba la gdan ma dang*/ rtse me tog gi bar du/ chag shing lnga lhag tsam yod pa 'od zer rab tu gsal ba gser gyi 'od zer 'gul zhing g.yo ba/ zo lu'i spos kyi sdong po thog la bdud rtsi bab pas/ 'od zer thams cad la 'phros/ bcu bdun gyi nyin/ 'od zer kha dog sna lnga rim pa brgyad shar/

yang sngon po/ dkar po/ dmar po/ 'od zer zhig shar/ byang shar nas byung*/ yang 'od zer ser po mchod rten gyi lha khang la 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang thog tu 'ja' kha dog sna lnga shar/ bco brgyad kyi nyin/ 'od zer sngon po/ lho nub nas shar/ gser gyi 'od zer/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rin po che'i gnam khang la shar/ yang gser lta bu/ 'ja' 'od dang sprin 'ja' shar/ zhes 'byung ba'i bas ho ni bya khrung khrung yin zhing*/ khyung zer ba rnams ni rgya skad s+pho hwang ste bya tshe ring gi ming yin no/ /rin po che'i mchod rten zhes pa dang*/ mchod rten gyi lha khang zhes pa ni dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod mdzad pa'i gnas kyi khang pa mchod rten lta bu'i bang rim thog brtsegs mang po can no// chos kyi rje pho brang nas thegs te rtse lngar bzhugs dus nyin re zhing mchod rten gyi grib ma la 'ja' 'od 'khrugs shing*/ 'ja' 'od las sku gzugs kyi rnam pa sogs ngo mtshar mang du byung ba rnams/ gong ma'i lung gis zhu yig 'phral 'phral du phul te/ 'di kho na'i lung yang bcu lhag zhig snang ba so so nas ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang bar 'dug /de skabs zhig gong mas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtho gang tsam pa nyi ma ltar 'bar ba gzigs/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes de'i nyin ston pa'i tshems mche ba rgya gar gyi yul gru chung ngu zhig na bzhugs pa de gong ma'i phyag tu byung bas/ chos rje rin po che'i thugs rjer mkhyen te gser gar blugs kyi ston pa'i sku ji ltar gzigs pa de tsam pa byas nas/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi zhu ba'i lung dang bcas te phyag tu phul/ spyir gong ma nyid kyi dgongs pas dmag gi sgo nas hor dus ltar bod khrims zhabs su 'dzug sa hor ltar mchod yon srid gcig pas rgyal khams gnon par dgongs kyang*/ chos rje rin po ches chos bzhin du bstan pas rgya dmag mdzad ma bde/

mthar gong mas bod yul de na chos brgyud mi gcig pa sna tshogs pa yod par 'dug pas de rnams rtsod pa 'ong*/ dmag dngos btang na chos kyi rje mi mnyes par 'dug pas/ gser thog gi gyo mo ga chur lus pa rnams skyel ba dang sbrag pa'i rta pa thor tsam zhig gtong*/ de tshos rta'i snga sha la gyo mo re khyer bas bde bar 'drongs 'gro/ chos brgyud thams cad khyed rang gi lugs su 'dril/ lo lo bzhin mdo khams rnams rab sgang dang dbus gtsang rnams chos 'khor chen po bskor ba byed pas gnang ba zhu zhus kyang*/ chos rgyud gcig kho nas sems can mi thul so so'i mos pa bzhin sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'jug pa yin/ so so rang rang gi lugs kyi chos tshul bzhin du byas na des chog pa yin gsung nas ma gnang*/ phyis kyang gong ma'i gser yig pa bod tu yongs pa 'bri gung gi rgyab se ru rong du bcom pa dang bod nas snyan phra zhu mi yang du ma byung nas/ rgya dmag yong la khad byung ba'i tshe phag mo gru pa'i dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis chos kyi rje'i drung du mgon med skyabs med kyi smre sngags mgo 'bul lus 'bul gyi zhu yig sum sbreng dngos su mthong*/ de dag gi tshe'ang thugs byams pa chen pos ni khyab/ khe grags dang dbang che 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni mi mnga'/ thams cad la phan bde 'ba' zhig dgongs pas bka' rin po che yang yang du bstsal bas/ rgyal po chen po des kyang bla ma'i gsung gi cod pan spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod pas rgya rnams phyi ma'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs/ bod rnams tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs/ mdor na bod yul rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med kyang*/ bod yul du bka' drin du go ba ni su yang mi snang zhing cung zad bde bar bsdad chog pa 'di rang rang gi pho rgod du rlom mod/ 'di 'dra ba kho na las rgyu 'bras mi shes pa 'di dag snying rje'i gnas kho na'o/

/des na mkhan chen bsod nams bzang pos/ de nyid phyi mar skye 'gro dpag med kyi/ /'jigs skyob dge legs 'grub pa'i dus mkhyen nas/ / bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i karma pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs pa yin zhing*/ drung rol pa'i rdo rjes ri 'di'i rtser dge slong gtsang ma zhig gi gdung sbyong na bod la rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhes rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis kyang byin gyi brlabs te/ sku skye ba phyi mar dngos su zlog pa yin no// de ltar bod yul ba 'jigs pa las bskyabs par ma zad drung 'di'i bka' drin las/ phag mo gru pa la chen ha wang bod srang tu sprul pa spel ba'i rgyal bu zhes bya ba'i lung las ka 'bri khung pa chen kya'u wang bstan pa spel ba'i rgyal bu gtsang stag tshang pa hu kya'u wang bstan pa skyong ba'i rgyal bu/ gling tshang pa tshan shan wang dge la rton ba'i rgyal bu/ go 'jo hu kya'u wang bstan pa srung ba'i rgyal bu/ zhes sogs kyi lung las ka du ma gnang ste bod yul bde bar mdzad do// spyir mchog gsum ga spyan drangs pa ni/ yab sras 'di'i dus su snang ba la gnas brtan bcu drug ni sngon yang byon pa dang*/ b-i+irba pa phyis ye dbang gi dus su'ang byon snang ngo*/ / ri bo rtse lnga'i kar sder bzhugs tshe/ rtse lnga'i ri re re la 'jam dpal sku mdog phyag mtshan tha dad re re gzigs shing dam pa'i chos kyi 'gro ba yun ring du mdzad/ dngos grub kyi chu mig cher 'phel zhing sar pa du ma brdol/ rin po che dmar po'i rigs zhig kyang gsar du brdol ba byung*/ de nas bod du 'byon dgos tshul gsungs pas rgyal po chen pos lar 'dir byon pa sku drin che ste/ yun ring ma song zhabs tog kyang che bar ma thengs/ spyir bla ma la rtag tu 'grogs kyang gsungs ma sgrub na byin rlabs mi 'byung bka' bzhin bsgrub na byin rlabs la nye ring med pa ni ngas go ba yin/

hor gyi dus na ni rgyal pos dbang che byed par 'dug / khyed nged kyi bla ma yin pas da khyed dbang che ba yin pas re shig 'byon la nam gdan 'dren pa'i tshe 'byon pa'i zhal bzhes mdzad dgos zhes gsol/ de ltar rgya nag hor yu gur mi nyag sogs kyi skye bo mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad nas/ rim gyis kan ci'u la lam byas te karma la brgyud de 'dan nas gdan sa chen po karmar glang lo'i smad ston gyi dus su phebs/ de nas ngoms/ lha steng*/ mdo gam rnams zhabs kyis bcag /de'i sos ka bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal rin po che las bzhengs/ de skor gyi dge 'dun rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bar mdzad/ zla stod smad/ chom la kha/ smar khams yan phal cher gyis de skor du mjal zhing*/ khyad par go 'jo bdag po lha sde dang bcas pa rgya'i ta'i zhing rnams dang bcas pas g.yu+u gshis su mjal/ skya ser thams cad chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ lcags mo yos lo'i dgun zla dang po tsam la gdan sa chen po karma nas bteg ste byang lam brgyud/ sog dang re rgyab tu sos ka'i bar bzhugs nas/ dbyar byang phyogs su kong dgon dang*/ gnam mtsho'i bkra shis do la byon/ de dag tu skye bo mtha' yas pa mngon mtho dang nges legs la sbyar/ 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas bod chung ngu'i phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur/ 'dam cog rtse lar phebs tshe/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal ngo*/ /'dri gdan stag gsum sogs rgya nag gi mnga' thang la ltos na dbus gtsang lho byang kun bsdoms kyang rgya'i mi dpon chung ngu'i chung ngu gcig gi 'byor ba la mi do bar snang mod/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas che ba'i phyir bod yul so so na lugs gnyis kyi bdag po bsam gyis mi khyab par bkur zhing bsnyems pa rnams kyis ja 'dren 'bul nod sngun bsu dang*/ rje tsong kha pa chen pos/ jo bo'i thugs dam rwa sgreng gi rten khyad par can me rngugs ma rgyal ba byams pa'i sku li dmar rkang gang tsam gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba/

sangs rgyas nyid du bstod bsngags mdzad pa'i zhu yig /zhabs la phyag bgyid par spro yang lo gsum gyi mtshams kyi bcad rgya zhig byas yod pa 'dis sgrub par ma nus zhu ba sogs dang*/ 'di tshe dge ldan btab nas lo lnga drug song ba tsam du 'dug /kun mkhyen rong ston shes bya kun rig sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bzhugs so 'tshal gyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon par nges par 'drongs pa'i zhu yig so so nas 'dug pa mang du bdag gi kyang mthong*/ 'dam gzhung la chibs rags theg bzhin pa la sa g.yos chen po byung nas ri bo'ang rgyug par cha ba'i tshe zhal snga nas rten gan+dho la myur du phob cig gsungs te sar bzhuḍa su gsol/ drung gis chibs gzhol te thub pa bdud 'dul ma'i tshul du bzhugs ma thag zhi ste sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa las skye 'gro skyob par mdzad/ dpal ldan mtshur phu dang lha ldan gyi ljongs su phyags phebs/ jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi snam sbyar rin thang med pa gsol/ dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas ban de lnga yod pa yan thams cad la ris med du mang ja gnang sbyin bzang po dang*/ gtsug lag khang thams cad du mchod rdzas rgya cher gnang*/ bdag po wang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gdan drangs pas sne'u gdong du byon/ dgun bzhugs yar lung gi khra 'brug tu mdzad nas/ bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa chen po dang*/ thel shod kyi zhal ngo*/ dpon skya/ dge 'dun/ skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ gang la gang 'tshams pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ dbus phyogs kyi lha sde dang*/ mi sde thams cad kyis zhabs mthil spyi bor blangs/

de'i tshe mdo stod smad kyi mi chen lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis spyan 'dren yang yang du btang*/ khyad par rje nyid kyi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i thu bo mi nyag rab sgang gi rma se'i 'dren pa/ mkhas pa mi lngar grags pa'i dge bshes khri phrag brgyad dgu'i nang na 'gran zla dang bral ba mkhas pa dang*/ grub pa'i yon tan gzhal bar mi nus pa rab sgang nyid kyi mkhas pa mi nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa de la/ spyan 'dren du khyed byon na cis kyang spyan drangs te yong bas 'byon dgos zhes thams cad kyis zhus pas chos kyi rje rin po che spyan e 'drongs mi shes/ 'on kyang khyed tshos bskul bas zhal ltar 'gro gsungs nas 'bul nod mtha' yas pa dang bcas te byon/ sne'u gdong du rje dang mjal/ chos rje rin po che'ang khyed dang 'phrad pa dga' gsung nas shin tu mnyes/ khong gis dbus gtsang 'di na sgra mi snyan na bstan pa med zer yod 'dug pa/ der bstan pa yod par thal/ der bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu sder longs pa yod pa'i phyir te/ der gnas brtan ba ku la 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i phyir/ 'di la lan thob cig ces sogs mang du bkod pa'i shog dril ring mo rdo ring dang khyams khra'i sgo la sbyar/ gra sa so sor bsrings pa na sus kyang lan 'debs mi ma byung snang bas/ rab dge gcig gis/ dbus dge de tsam zil gyis mnan snang ste/ lan ma thebs pa ni rtsod kyang rung ma rtsod kyang rung pham pa'i tshad du bshad pa yin no// gong ma chen po'i drung du'ang*/ phag mo gru pas gzhi byas/ bod thams cad gong ma khyed kyi chab 'og yin zhes pa'i ka'o dang*/ bod kyis ngo lta ba brdzangs pa'i lan/ lung bzang po gnang sbyin dang bcas pa der pheb nas thams cad bde zhing skyid par byas/ chu pho 'brug gi lo la gdan sa chen po mtshur phur chags phebs/ der yang sa g.yos kyis zhig ral byung ba rnams gso dgos pa'i zhal ta gnang*/

thugs dam gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa dang*/ mtshur phu'i zhig gsos mkhan chen pa la chos ka gsan pa sogs legs par grub nas/ slar yang kong por byon/ tsā ri la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can rnams su/ yi dam gyi lha'i gzigs snang dpag med byung ba snang*/ spyir mchog gi sprul ba'i sku 'di lta bu'i dag pa rab 'byams kyi gzigs pa skad cig re'i tshul yang su zhig gis bgrang zhing dpyad par nus/ des na rnam thar le'u tse ma sogs su bkod pa mang du yod par snang na'ang*/ rnam thar phyi ma tshor ma bkod par snang ngo*// slar yang dgon pa gong 'og rnams su byon/ chos zab la rgya che bas thams cad tshim par byas/ dwags kong ral gyi skye bo'i tshogs thams cad mthong thos dran reg gi sgo nas sku de nyid kyis gdul ba'i sems can rnams yongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas/ slar yang dbus su byon/ jo bo rin po che dang mjal cing*/ brag lha klu phug sogs su bzhugs/ de nas dol mtshal min du byon nas mkhan chen rin po che dang*/ yab sras chos kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med par mdzad/ sngar drung rang byung ba'i dus nas tshal pas phul ba'i g.yor po dol gyi mchod gzhis rnams/ mkhan chen snyag phu pa la lha 'bangs su gnang ste/ des tshal min gyi gtsug lag chen po'i sde mdzad/ de nas gang dkar brgyud lha sar phebs te/ skyi 'phan gyi bdag po gzhis ka sne'u pas lha sa po ta la phul nas gzims khang mdzad nas bzhugs/ 'dir ting nge 'dzin shin tu 'phel/ ring po mi thogs par gzhan don rgya chen por gzhan zhig yong bar 'dug gsung nas tha ma'i mdzad pa lung du bstan/ bod gangs can gyi skye bo mchog dman skya ser thams cad rgyun mi 'chad par 'dus te/ shākya'i dbang po dang spyan ras gzigs lhan cig pa'-i zhal lta/ chos kyi 'khor lo ni gaṅgā ltar rgyun mi 'chad/ nyin cig gis 'gro ba smin grol du mdzad pa yang sus bgrang bar nus/

gong ma'i 'bul chen yang lan gsum du sleb pa'i gcig la gar kang 'brug sder lnga ma 'khyil pa bdun re 'am lnga re logs la yod pa/ mthil du gong ma'i mtshan gyi rgya nag gi yi ge sngo khra bzhi yod pa shubs bcas kho na mi res lag pa so sor re re bzung ba lha sa'i phyi skor chen mo la bsgrengs zhing*/ de nas po ṭa lar bzhugs khri'i drung gi bar sbrengs pa phul bar grags/ spyir yang pho brang du phebs dus gsol dkar du me tog gan dkar zhes grags pa phyi nang cung zad kyang mi sgrib pa dar las kyang srab pa phul ba phyis gsol ja bas phyi ba shed ches pas 'thor te/ de bas cung zad mthug tu btang ba'i khyad dkar du ma phul zhing de dag gi 'og nas khyad dkar 'di mchog tu gyur pa ste/ bdag gis gzhon dus kyang 'ga' zung mthong la da ni cher mi snang mod/ 'di la ltos na deng sang gi kar gang snang ba 'di rnams snyigs ma ltar snang ngo*// ja yang bzhes ja la pad+ma'i ge sar khyad par can dang*/ rgya mtsho pha ri'i ja zhes sogs phul bar grags so/ /gan dril yang gser dmar po las rdza ma dang*/ gser ser po las mgo rdor blugs pa rdo rje pha lam gyis rwa rtse dang*/ rwa'i logs rnams su phra byas pa dang*/ zi khyim las dril bu byas pa de 'dra pa sogs mang du phul ba da lta'ang phyag na du ma bzhugs te/ khyad dril dngos ni 'di yin la rdor dril 'di ni gong ma 'di'i dus ma gtogs/ rgya nag snga ma mi nyag hor gang gi dus su'ang ma byung snang ngo*/ /khyad dril du grags pa rwa log can gzhan las legs pa rnams ni bla ma rnam gsum la gnang ba'i tshan no// de skabs karma nas si tu rin po ches gdan 'dren la byon/ mjal dar kha btags nyin mo bde legs ma che ba zhig phul bas phyag gis bzhes te/ de kar phyag mdud gnang nas phyag gis gtad de/ si tu pa 'di ma nyams par zung zhig gsung pas dad rten sgom du bzhag /mdor na grub thob chen po nyid rgyal po mo gor gan kho na'i don du byon pa ltar rje 'di yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang bka' bgros pa'i phrin las kyis gong ma rgyal po'i don dang*/

bod rgya dmag las skyob pa'i don kho nar byon pa yin yang gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol du zhar gyis mdzad/ sngon dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i dus su/ slob ma zhig la khrid mdzad pas khos ma sgom par nyal bsdad pas khang thog nas dbu rib tsam sku stod rib tsam yang yang byung*/ phyis kho drung du byung dus/ zhal 'dzum 'dzum mang du mdzad pas skrag ste/ tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas sgom chen ches bzang ba zhig byung*/ de lta bu'i thabs mkhas dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa las/ slob ma rtogs ldan gzhan don nus pa thon pa ni rje 'di kho na mang bar grags la/ spyir gzhan las rmad du byung ba ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bstan par grags so// de ltar sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams 'dul bar mdzad nas/ sgar pa kha cig gis mi srun pa'i spyod pa byung ba na/ rma se rtogs ldan gyis 'di pa la bka' bkyon re tsam zhu zhus pas/ kho bo la zhe sdang skye ma myong bas khro mi shes par 'dug /'on kyang khyod kyi bsam pa gang ba zhig myur du bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang bar ngag sgros las 'chad/ mdor na mkhas pa thams cad kyi the tshom bsal/ bsam gtan pa thams cad yang dag pa'i lta sgom la bkod/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mi chen thams cad la phyag gis dbang bskur zhing chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ mthong thos dran reg la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag ste/ mdo khams kyis spyan 'dren pa rnams la yang myur du 'phrad par bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas dgung lo so gnyis pa/ shing mo lug gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar ngo la/ sku 'brum gyi bsnyun bzhes pa'i tshul bstan pa na brtan bzhugs phul bas rten 'brel zhig gis/ mdo khams karma'i nye logs su 'dun pa btad zin der gsol ba thob thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin gsung ba dang*/ gzim dpon la dpe cha lha rten rnams ma mthor ba gyis bdag po zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs te zla ba brgyad pa'i bco lnga'i nyin dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su bsdu bar mdzad cing*/

mkhan chen rin po che bsod bzang po sogs phebs te mchod pa'i bya ba mdzad/ sku gdung rin po che zhugs la bzhen pa na yang ring bsrel las grub pa'i bde dgyes kyi sku sogs dpag med byon la lha sa'i skor gyi nam mkha' mtha' dag zla ba du ma'i bar du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad/ mchod sbyin gyi dge rtsa spel ba'ang karmar cung rgyas pa dang*/ de 'og mtshur phu/ de 'og dge 'dun sgang pa dpon slob sogs dang lha sar mchod sbyin ji ltar mdzad tshul yi ge cung zad tsam snang zhing*/ dngul gyi gdung 'bum dang*/ sku 'dra rin po che mtshur phur bzhugs shing zhal bzhugs dus kyi thugs dam bka' bstan 'gyur gser las bsgrubs pa shin tu legs shing dag pa de'i bka' 'gyur mtshur phu dang gzhan karma na bzhugs so/ /khyad par gdung skal gong ma rgyal po'i mchod gnas su phul ba rnams la/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas lhag par rgya che ba dang*/ mchod pa'i rten khyad par bar bzhugs te mchod sprin gzhal du med pa byung bar snang ngo*// slob ma'i gtso bo 'ang*/ go'i shri sangs rgyas rin chen/ go'i shri blo gros rgyal mtshan/ go'i shri rin chen dpal/ go'i shri don grub 'od zer/ go'i shri chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ go'i shri shākya bzang po/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes/ ngom pa bya bral/ sgam po pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rma se rtogs ldan/ mi nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ mi nyag rtogs ldan/ kong nag ral gri/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bgrang gi mi lang ba/ rgya bod hor mi nyag thams cad du byung zhing*/ gong ma tā ming g.yun lo chen po dang*/ btsun mo dam pa de ni thugs rgyud kyi rtogs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pas slob ma'i thu bor gyur pa dang*/ dad stobs chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen yang*/ gdan sa thel gyi spyan snga bsod grags pa/

spyan snga sgo sel ba/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bri gung spyan snga don grub rgyal po/ bla ma pan+ṭita/ yangs pa chos rje shāka bzang ba/ jo gdan dbu yon pa/ zhwa lu ba slob dpon tsan+d+ra la sogs pa mtha' yas so// ༈¿¿de las go'i shri blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ drung gong ma'i dus nas mkhan chen gu'i gung pa'i phyags phyir lugs gnyis kyi bya ba mdzad/ gu'i gung pa gshegs rjes drung 'dis gu'i gung pa'i las ka bzhes te/ lugs gnyis kyi bya ba chen po rnams mdzad/ phyis mchog gi sprul pa'i sku seng ge'i khrir spyan drangs/ gu'i gung pa re zhig mdzad de rtse lha sgang du gshegs nas/ sku 'bum yang bzhugs so// ༈¿¿'jam dbyangs chen po don grub 'od zer pa ni/ grub thob chen po karma pak+shi'i mched ya gtsug tor skyabs kyi brgyud pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sras che ba yin/ chos rje rin po che las gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing*/ thugs dam gy-i rtsal rdzogs/ gzigs rgya dang mkhyen pa che bas 'jam dbyangs chen por mtshan gsol/ chos rje'i bka' drin las gser gyi tham ga /kwan ting go'i shri'i las ka ka po ming dang bcas pa gnang*/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum mdzad/ chos kyi gnad khyad par ba mang po gsungs pas gzhan rnams kyi blor ma chud/ kun mkhyen rong pos lung pa 'di'i phu na gzhan mi zer ba mang po zer ba zhig yod 'dug pa ltar 'gro gsung nas byon te mjal/ chos kyi bgro bas dad ste 'jam dbyangs chen po la chos gsan/ phyis lo tsā ba chen po bsod nams rgya mtshos kyang khams su 'bul sdud la 'gro ba la/ karma pa mang bas de'i bshad rgyu tsam re dgos par 'dug dgongs nas mjal du byon pas/ stan las bzhengs nas gom pa du mas bsus/ phyag lan rtse sprod mdzad/ bzhugs stan mnyam par bshams/ ston mo bzang po mdzad cing chos ye ma gsungs/ nyin re zhing chos kyi 'bel gtam byung ba la ni tshad gzhal bar ma nus nas mkhyen pa'i thugs rgyal zhi/
