blos je mi dpogs su song*/ thugs ni rings par yod kyang de lta'i ngang du zla gcig tsam song tshe/ mtshan mo zhig thugs mthong 'di 'dra mdzad cing*/ chos ye mi gnang ba ci yin snyam/ ga re chos chos bzhin du nyan dgos pa la nged rang nga rgyal ches lta ba mthos chos la yang*/ nor tshol ba'i yon gyi 'du shes las dad pas ma nyan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes ma skyes par 'phral 'grogs dang so skye'i 'du shes las ma byung bas/ chos kyi snod ma yin par 'dug snyam nas/ rang la thugs skyo ste spyan chab mang du byung*/ 'jam dbyangs chen po rang la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas nang zhogs gzhan las snga bar gdan 'dren byung*/ byon pa na bla ma nyid khri la bzhugs/ ldang ba dang phyag kyang mi mdzad/ byin rlabs kyang phyag gis mdzad/ mdun na grum ze zhig bting 'dug pa la der bzhugs gsungs nas/ 'o chos 'dod pa bya ba de ltar byed dgos pa yin gsung nas de ma thag nas zab mo nang don gyi dbu btsugs mtha' drug tshul bzhi dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa rgyud lugs su mdzad pa la khong gis zin bris mdzad snang ba nang don gyi ṭīka byed sog 'grel sogs phyi ma thams cad las khyad par du 'phags par snang zhing*/ thugs rings pa bzhag ste gdams ngag dang nyams khrid du ma gsan/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa yang skyes/ yang paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen/ kun mkhyen bkras rnam pa/ rngaug byang chub dpal ba rje 'di rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma gang la 'tshol lam snyam pa na 'jam dbyangs chen pos khyed rang dang las 'brel yod pa paṇa chen nags rin yin pas rtsa ba'i bla mar zung gsung ba dang*/ brtag pa yang de ltar du shar nas phyis paṇa chen gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa ma gtogs rtsa ba'i dad pa 'dir thob pa yin no// bstan bcos kyang du ma mdzad de deng sang mtshur lugs su grags pa rnams 'jam dbyangs pa'i mdzad byang can yin no/

/'on kyang de'i tshe las tshan rnams mang zhing rags pas nang so tshang mdzad dka' cung zad yod pas las tshan rnams la kha gnon gyi rten 'brel mang du mdzad snang ba ni cung phyi nang gnyis kar du non ches pa'i mtshan ma snang ngo*// mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba na paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan pa dpon slob rnams mtshur phur mjal bar phebs kyang*/ da len mjal yang stabs cung zad mi legs pas/ thugs gnyer gnang 'os rnams gnas nang du byon la slob dpon pa la gsan par mdzod ces mtshams sbyor gnang*/ de nas mi ring bar gshegs pas mngon mkhyen du dgongs/ 7rje mthong ba don ldan mya ngan las 'das rjes go'i shri chen po dpal 'byor don grub kyis dgongs rdzogs su gser thog gi bya 'dab chung ba gnyis bskyon par phebs tshe/ 'di nged la gnod pas re zhig zhog gsung yang ma gsan/ mdzod nag chen mo'ang*/ dus ngan byung na yul ngan skyid pa yin gsung nas rtse lha sgang du drangs pa la'ang thugs cung ma rangs/ sgar pa'i gser thog 'grub par 'dug ste/ kho bo'ang 'degs dgos par 'dug /mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal mi mthong bar 'dug gsung nas gshegs/ zhag bdun du pur la ma reg gsung yang zhag bdun pa la reg pas thugs kar drod tsha chil chil ba 'dug pa de ma thag tu yal song*/ 'di kun mkhyen rong pos gsan pas mtshur phu ba la mi med par 'dug /zhu ba glus bskul byas na bzhengs par 'dug pa la gsungs skad/ drung na rim ma gtogs pa'i mtshur phu'i gdan rabs la mkhyen rab dang 'phrin las 'di che bar 'khums/

dpal ldan mtshur phu'i gdan rabs ni/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i 'og tu lho la yag pas gdan sa lo gsum mdzad/ de rjes stod lung gram pa ba bla ma rang byung sangs rgyas kyi lo drug tu gdan sa mdzad/ de nas gya pa gangs pa dang*/ rgya mtsho bla ma/ rin chen grags pa khu dpon gsum gyis rim par lo gsum re mdzad/ de rjes grub chen karma pak+shi lo mang du bzhugs/ de rjes snag dbon rin po ches lo gsum/ de rjes bla ma gnas nang pas gdan sa mdzad rjes/ rje'i dbon a dbang ye shes dbang phyug gi sras drung bkra shis 'bum pa bzhugs/ de rjes a mye a dpal gyi sras bla ma dbang rin gyis gdan sa mdzad thog rang byung zhabs rgya yul du pheb skabs tshad ma pan+ṭi tas gdan sa zla ba drug bzung*/ rang byung gong nas yar pheb nas bla ma gnas nang ba la gdan sa gtad/ de rjes nang pa chos bzang dang*/ de rjes bla ma dbang rin pa'i mched ya nang pa chos rgyal gdan sar bzhugs/ gong nas gu'i gung pa'i las ka dang*/ gser tham/ shel gyi thar shu/ shel gyi bar sga rnams pheb/ de rjes rje rol pa'i rdo rje lo kha shas bzhugs nas slar nang ba chos rgyal ba la/ kwan ting gu'i shri'i las ka /shel tham 'brug ma/ dngul yig sgor mo sogs pheb/ de rjes mched ya chos blo ba gdan sa lo lnga mdzad/ de rjes dbon po dka' thub kyi sras che ba rin po che kun dga' blo gros kyis gdan sa lo lnga/ de rjes mched ya chos kyi 'od zer pas gdan sa lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi mdzad/ de rjes khong gi dbon po go'i shri don grub 'od zer bzhugs pa 'di nyid gdan rabs nyi shu pa'o// ༈ go'i shri chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ 'phags yul du grub chen ḍom+bi pa dang*/ rgya nag gi sngags 'chang 'jam dpal gsang ba'am gyim shang nag po zhes bya ba/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyis gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa dpyad la/ gdan drangs te gnas rnying gis yul phul/ slob dpon pad+mas sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe stobs ldan nag po'i bka' babs pas 'jig rten gyi dregs pa thams cad dbang du 'dus shing*/

mchog gi dngos grub kyang brnyes pa zhig dang*/ bod yul du mar ston chos kyi blo gros/ de nas rnam 'phrul rim brgyud lta bus/ rje dwags po'i dbon sgom tshul gyi sku mched sgom chung shes rab byang chub/ 'gro mgon ras chen/ grub chen pak+shi'i sku'i rim gro pa rnal 'byor ye shes dbang phyug ste/ phyis 'bri rgyud 'dan stod smad du dgon sde mang du bskyangs pa'i rnam thar can dang*/ rdza rgyud chung bar ri mgo dgon du sgrub sde btsugs pas ri mgo par grags pa/ dpal lha steng dang nye ba nags 'go na bzhugs te sgrub sde bskyangs pas/ rje btsun nags mgo par yang grags te/ sgom chen nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa lnga brgya lhag pa dus thams cad du bskyangs zhing*/ gdan sa karma dang lha steng gnyis ka'i zhabs tog rgya cher bgyis pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung ba dang rol pa'i rdo rje gnyis ka'i zhal slob tu gyur ba/ mtshan dngos rin chen 'byung gnas/ de dang dus mtshungs su rgya nag tu tā'i ming rgyal po chen po'i blon po ta'i zhing du grags pa/ grub chen birba pa spyan 'dren gyi pho nyar mngags pa dang*/ rgya mtsho la gru gzings bcas te dzam bu gling lan gsum bskor nas/ po ṭa la sogs gnas chen rnams su rgyal pos mchod 'bul mdzad pa'i dgongs pa skong ba po de rnams dang thugs rgyud gcig par zhal gyis bzhes te/ si tu'i mtshan can rim par byon pa rnams kyi thog ma yin zhing*/ gdan sa bar du grub chen pak+shi'i gdung rigs dbu shes rab me lce'i mched ya thugs rje rgya hob kyi sras su 'khrungs/ sbyangs yon gyis phyug cing khyad par rje de bzhin gshegs pa las don rgyud kyi ye shes ngo 'phrod pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur/ gdan sa'i si tu'i go sar bzhugs pa las/ tā'i ming rgyal pos tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung pos brgyan pa'i theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsngags pa'i lung gser tham dang 'jā' sa phul ba'i mtshan/

kwan tin dben thong me'u tsi go'i shri ste/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa brtse ldan 'jig rten gyi bla ma zhes grags/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgya yul du phebs pa'i tshe/ sku rim du gdan sa bar du rgyud sde'i dkyil chog mang du btsugs/ thugs dam gser dngul gyi bka' bstan 'gyur yang bzhengs/ rgyal ba'i dbang po rgya nag nas yar phebs skabs karmar spyan drangs nas dpon slob khri phrag mang por shangs len zhabs tog rgya cher mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po zhi dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshe'ang dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi karmar btang zhing*/ phyogs kyi 'dus sde thams cad du'ang mang 'gyed sogs bsam 'das bsgrubs/ phyi rten du ston pa'i sku dang*/ nang rten du rje nyid kyi sku khri rgyan dang bcas pa gser zangs las bzhengs pa dang*/ gser rkyang gis bka' 'gyur ro cog phul byung bzhengs te/ rje mkha' spyod par phul ba sogs dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ de bzhin gshegs pa karmar phebs skabs nyid nas dgongs pa zhus te/ gdan sa si tu shākya bzang po la gtad/ nyid kun spangs mdzad nas dgongs rdzogs kyi skabs 'di dag dang*/ 'chad nyan gnang dgos tsam ma gtogs/ phal cher dben pa kho nar bzhugs pas kun spangs rin po cher yang grags/ rje don ldan zhabs sku phra mo nas spyan drangs shing zhabs tog mdzad/ slob ma'ang rig grol gyi yon tan dang ldan pa mang du byung ngo*// ༈¿¿go shri shākya bzang po ni/ dbon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi sras chos kyi rgyal mtshan nyid kyi dbon po yin te/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi sku drin las/ gong ma chen po'i kwan tin go shrī'i las ka ka bo ming dang bcas pa gnang ste/ gong smos ltar karma'i gdan sa bskyangs pas si tu shākya bzang por grags pa'o// ༈¿¿zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa gsum pa chos dpal ye shes ni/ mkha' spyod dbang po nyid kyi rnam thar gsang sgron du/

phyi dus sngags spyod rnal 'byor kun tu rgyu/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ kong lung ral gsum las nyang kha lung pa chos kyi sde zhes 'dogs pa'i sa'i cha'i/ bye brag khe nang gi brag mdo zhes pa'i grong du/ yab bsam grub kyi ming can/ rus pa khu'i rigs su byung ba/ shing mo glang gi lo pa nyi shu rtsa gcig lon zhing*/ brdzun dang g.yo med pa dang tshul bzang la drang por smra ba dang*/ yum yang dad pa dang ldan la sems bzang ba/ yab de las lo gcig gis gzhon pa/ me pho stag gi lo ma rus las ming du chags pa/ bar za zhes bya ba dag lhan cig tu 'khod pa'i tshe/ yum gyi rmi lam du/ spang gshongs shin tu bde bar cha ther dkar po phub 'dug pa'i gseb tu phyin pas/ bud med dar yol zhig chu gnyis zom gang bskur nas/ 'di ma po bar nyar gyis zer gyis/ de khur te ri logs la 'dzegs pa na/ dgon pa gcig tu slebs/ de'i phyogs gar phyin thams cad du lo legs pa'i snye ma bzang po snang ba las mang du btogs nas tshags byas pa dang*/ ban de rta pa zhwa theb gon pa mang po thag nye bar 'gro ba dang*/ khong rang dbang ba'i mkhar gyi rtse mor dar phyar ba dang*/ nyi ma shar ba dang*/ rang gi gos rnying pa rnams bor te gsar pa bzang la mang po gon pa dang*/ g.yu mtsho che ba'i rgyan mang po btags pa dang*/ g.yu rdog mang po rnyed pa dang*/ rtswa sngon po bzang po mang du btus nas nya ra byas pa'i rmis ltas rnams byung zhing*/ yab gyi rmi lam du'ang*/ mkhar gyi rtse mor ba dan sngon po 'phyar ba dang*/ mgo la g.yung mar byug pa sogs ltas dge ba 'byung ngo*// dngos su'ang lhums su zhugs nas zla ba 'ga' song ba na/ mngal du ma ṇi'i sgra ha cang gsal ba m-in tsam grags pa la/ yum sngon bu btsa' ma myong pa'i gzhon nu mar song bas/ gzhan bu ltor yod pa rnams la skad 'di ltar yong ba yin nam snyam pa dang*/ res 'ga' grang ba'i skad yin te 'ong bsam nas/

mi la smra ma phod par gnas pa la/ nu mo dang grogs gzhan gyis thos te dri ba'i lan/ gong ltar brjod pas/ bud med rgan pa bu mang du skyes pas kyang*/ dang po nas mi skad mi 'ong zhing*/ lhag par yang ma ṇi bgrang ba'i skad gsal la 'di ngo mtshar che ba yin zhes gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de/ grags pa che bar gyur to// grong mi byin gyis mthun snang du grub pa la'ang*/ mkhar de'i rtse mo la 'ja' tshon gdugs kyi rnam pa sgor mo gcig gi phyogs bzhir ka ba ltar gyen du zug pa dang*/ res 'ga' logs la dar 'phyar ba 'dra ba rgyun du byung zhes kha mthun par smra'o/ /de nas lhums su zhugs dus kyi zla ba rdzogs te/ me pho khyi'i lo kong po grong rtsis pa'i dbyar zla ra ba rgya hor gyi lugs kyi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi skar ma rgyal dang ldan pa'i/ nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs su sku bltams pa de yang*/ gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa/ yan lag dang nying lag rdzogs shing*/ dpral ba dbyes che ba/ dbu gdugs lta bu zhabs mthil la me ri'i dbus su hor yig gsar gyi rgyal ces pa'i ri mos mtshan pa zhig btsas so/ /'khrungs nas zla ba lnga lon pa'i mtshams su sum mkhar ba 'ga' der 'ongs nas byin rlabs zhu ba la rim pa ltar phyag dbang mdzad/ yab kyis brag mdo nas 'bras bu gdan drangs pa la brag mdo pa rnams kyis skyel thung byas pa'i sar mgo la mar byugs pa gcig ma gtogs gzhan thams cad la phyag dbang rim pa bzhin mdzad/ yul de skor gyi pha la a jo zhes 'bod pa'i lugs yod pa ltar smra ba bslab pa'i thog mar a jo gyis zhes smras kyang a pha zhes bod spyi'i ngag dang mthun par gsungs pas thams cad ha las par gyur la/ de bzhin du smra ba'i dus la bab pa nas/ yul skad ngan pa dang ma 'dres pa'i skad ya mtshan du 'dzin pa gsungs pa sogs kyi gtam snyan thos pa la brten nas/ dge slong dpon grags pa dang*/ bla ma chos bzang pa rnam gnyis kyis brtag pa bya ba'i ched du/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen byams pa dang*/ dge slong dpal ldan rgyal mtshan sogs btang nas/ bshes gnyen byams pas gong gi lo rgyus thams cad yi ger bkod de/ e ma/ mtshungs med rgyal dbang de yi thugs rje yis// mos ldan gdul bya rtse gcig 'dun rnams la// bzung ngam 'on te min zhes som nyi la// 'di bris mtshan ltas rnams la gzigs te dpyod// ces sogs zla ba brgyad pa yan gyi mdzad spyod rags pa bskur ba dang*/ ngag las gsal ba rnams kyis yid ches skyes nas sngon gyi grwa pa gzhan dag mjal ba la yang rgyus yod kyis bslab pa ma yin par ngo mkhyen nas/ de'i lo rgyus gsungs pas khyad par du yid ches te/ yab yum la 'di ni bdag cag gi bla ma de'i sku skye yin par nges pas cis kyang*/ nged bu chen zhal slob rnams kyis gdan drangs te sku bskyed bsring pa 'thad ces dran bskul yang yang byas na'ang gcung po shākya dbang phyug kyang*/ de nas lo bdun pa 'brug lo la skyes pa yin pas/ de'i dus su bu gcig por bzung nas khyod kyi bla ma'i sprul sku min kyang chog / nged kyi bu su la'ang mi gtad zer nas/ de phyin chad btsun pa su yang 'phrad du ma ster ba la/ dge slong dpon grags pa dang bla ma chos bzang ba rnam pa gnyis kyis/ mo rtsis pa'i sngags pa rnams la/ nyang chu 'gram du sku khrus dang bsangs len mang du byed dgos pa'i rim gro phog tu bcug cing*/ 'khrung nas lo ngo bzhi pa tsam la dus tshes bsgrigs te grwa pa 'ba' zhig gis/ nyang chu'i ko gzhung las/ yab yum sras gsum dbang med la gdan drangs nas stag rtser yun ring du bzhugs pas stag rtse sprul sku zhes grags shing*/ dgung lo lnga drug tsam lon pa'i tshe/ 'o 'bug phur phal gyis bgrod par dka' ba'i brag bya skyibs shin tu mtho ba bya rgod kyi gnas su rung bar thogs pa med par byon pa la/ 'khor dag gis gsol ba btab pas/ ci ltar byon pa ma mthong bar pheb pa dang*/

rag dang rtsigs pa gang la'ang ma thogs par nang du rgyu ba mdzad cing*/ gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa'i mngon shes mang du mdzad par snang yang*/ grwa pa rgan gzhon phal mo ches mdzad spyod rtsub cing sku rtsal che ba dang*/ thugs grung por 'dzin pa las/ rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa'i yon tan du bzung ba nyung nge ba las ma byung ba yin no/ /zhes rgan po dag gis ngag tu gleng ba las thos so// de nas rim gyis mar steng dang*/ dga' ldan ma mor byon te sngar gyi gdul bya dag la lo rgyus rgyas par gsungs shing yon bdag gcig la gdams pa ni/ dus gsum mkhyen gzigs bla ma rin po che mkhyen/ bla ma rang sems yin/ byin rlabs mos gus yin/ ting nge 'dzin mnyam bzhag yin/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin/ cha tsam ldan pa nyid du gyur// bla ma rje la mos gus dang*// dag snang phyogs med byed pa ces// smin grol bde la bkod mdzad pa'i// btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod// yon tan thugs dgongs rdzogs phyir bris// zhes gsungs/ drung gong ma'i zhal chems phyag bris su mdzad pa ngo bo dga' ldan ma mo'i phyag mdzod kyi sgam du bcug /ngos bshus byes su khyer ba las phyi ma thams cad kyis mthong bar mdzad zin kyang*/ ngo bo phyags 'debs dus 'dir bzhag pa yin gsungs nas bton te bstan pas/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyis thog drangs yid tshim pa'i nges shes skyes so// de dag gi tshe bla ma chos kyi bzang po'i drung du/ rdo rje phag mo so bdun ma'i dbang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho pad+ma zab rgyal/ ber nag can rigs bsdus sogs kyi dbang dang sgrub thabs ma lus pa gsan zhing*/ grub chen karma pak+shi/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang po rnams kyi gsung sgros tshang ma dang*/ chos drug /phyag chen/ rlung sems gnyis med/ rdzoḍa chen/ gsang 'dus rim lnga/ rgyud 'bum gyi lung rnams kyang gsan no/ / bla ma 'di rje rgod tshang pa'i sprul pa gzigs te/

bstod pa mdzad/ bla ma dge slong dpon grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ rdzogs chen rgyud bcu bdun/ snying thig /snying po don gsum/ bsre ba bskor gsum/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gyi dbang bskur la sogs pa gsan/ dgung lo bdun bzhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo'i ston rgyab spo bo phyogs kyi grwa pa yon bdag rnams kyis zhu nan phul ba ltar/ ye gong la sogs par byon/ dad pa ldan pa rnams kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog rgya cher byas shing*/ gsung chos bsngo ba gang la gang 'tsham thugs nas gsungs pas/ skya ser thams cad dad pa brtan po thob par mdzad do// dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa dbus kyi mal gro nas rim gyis bang mdor pheb pa dang mjal/ de'i nyin mo kho nar yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ dpon slob lhan du pheb pa'i lam du'ang*/ chos thun re ma chag par gsan/ stag rtser lo de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la/ chos rje rin po che de bzhin gshegs pas mkhan po dang*/ gu shrī 'go blon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon mdzad de dge 'dun dang bcas pas rab tu byung zhing dge tshul mdzad pa'i dus/ mtshan yang chos kyi dpal ye shes zhes 'dogs par mdzad cing*/ tshangs par spyod par brtan par gnas so//

mkhan po chos kyi rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du/ snga phyir gsung chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs kyang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ rdo rje phag mo lhan cig skyes ma dang*/ ye shes mgon po ber nag can rnams kyi sgrub skor zhal gdams rdzogs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'ang gsan zhing lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor/ chos drug mkhar kha ma/ do ha/ phyag chen yi ge 'bru bzhi pa/ 'brel pa bzhi ldan/ rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig /chos drug /lhan cig skyes sbyor/ sku gsum ngo sprod/ ni gu chos drug /gcod/ ras chung snyan brgyud/ u rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ rdzogs chen/ lam 'bras la sogs pa lung khrid mang du gsan/ de dus rgya nag la sogs pa'i yul khams skad rigs mi gcig pa mang po la mnga' mdzad pa/ gong ma chos kyi rgyal po yun los/ ta'i ba'u hā wang gi bla ma'i skye ba 'khrungs par gsan nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ rdo rje dril bu shubs bcas/ gos 'jam jus ta hung gi sku chos dmar smug ri mo can gyi sku sham dang*/ sku 'gag ta hung ri mo can nang dar dang bcas pa gos lu hang gi rgyan ldan/ ber thul ta hung dang gser ma nang dar bcas pa/ gos phrug ta hung gi dbu zhwa sogs dang*/ rjes su chos rjes zhus nas zhwa dmar gyi gnang sbyin yang byung ngo*// shing mo lug gi lo la lha sa dang nye ba/ po ta lar/ chos kyi rje rin po che de bzhin gshegs pa zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul bskur ba mdzad cing*/ dus mchod gsol 'debs rgyud ldan yang mdzad do/ /sa pho khyi'i lo dgung lo bcu gsum pa la/ snye bo'i yul gyi lha sde mi sdes gdan drangs te/ yul der byon drel mang du phul ba la brten nas rjes su yang gzim drel brgyad bcu lhag tsam du 'phel bar gyur/ yul khams der gnas pa thams cad chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim zhing bde legs dang ldan par mdzad de/

slar kong por phebs/ dgon gsum gyi thog drangs ri dgon klung dgon yon bdag dang bcas pa'i 'dzin skyong yang dag pa mdzad pa thams cad kyang dar rgyas che bar gnas shing*/ de dag gi dus sogs snga phyir/ rdza dgon kun spangs pa chos kyi ye shes zhes bya ba/ chos kyi rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i bu chen du gyur ba zhig gdan drangs te/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ gsang 'dus rim lnga dmar khrid/ gser ldings pas mdzad pa'i nag khrid skor/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ lha mo bzhis zhus/ rnam bzhag rim pa rnams kyi bshad pa/ bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi steng nas khrid dang*/ ngo sprod yu mo lugs/ dge ldan pa'i lugs kyi gdan rdzogs gsal sgron la sogs pa dang*/ u rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi skor mkhas btsun pa dang*/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i yig cha rnams kyi lung dang*/ sbyor drug dang*/ ras chung snyan rgyud khrid yig /rdo rje phag mo dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sgrub skor rnams kyi lung*/ mkha' spyod bsnyen sgrub/ 'brel pa gsum ldan/ sku gsum ngo sprod/ gcod yul/ blo sbyong*/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid/ dmar zhabs skor/ bi ma la snying thig gi skor rnams kyi khrid/ rje mar pa'i shog dril bzhi ma'i skor/ bsre 'pho'i skor brgyud pa so so las byung ba chos tshan mang po dang*/ bsre 'pho gcig car ba phyag rgya chen po'i gzhung gdams ngag /yang dgon pa'i ri chos thabs lam skor/ pan+ṭi ta don yod rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i man ngag rdo rje'i tshig 'byed la sogs pa'i lung*/ tshe dpag med dze tā ri mdzad pa'i gzhung sgrub dkyil 'bri gung lo tsā'i yig cha la brten pa'i dbang*/ thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rjes gnang*/ sgrub skor las tshoḍa bla ma bai ro nas brgyud pa dang*/ tshe bdag g.yung ston pa'i lugs chos tshan mang po dang*/

rtsa brgyud sdig pa snying 'dzin sogs lcags sdig gi bskor/ gdams pa shāg 'bum nas brgyud pa rnams kyi lung*/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi rjes gnang*/ sgrub thabs kyi lung*/ bka' gdams lam rim/ dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa'i bstan rim/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu/ bka' srung trag shad kyi sgrub skor rnams dang bcas pa'i lung*/ gshin rje gshed kyi rdzogs rim spros med kyi khrid/ rin chen bcud bsdus la sogs pa'i man ngag mang du gsan no// skabs gcig ba yor bzhugs pa na/ bya bral ston pa zhes bya bas ngo sprod zhus pa'i lan du/ shrī badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ bde stong gnyis med bsre ba 'di// lhan skyes chos sku'i ngo bo yin// ma yengs de yi ngo la blta// de tshe chos sku rtogs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ me pho spre'u'i lo la/ chos rje karma pa mthong ba don ldan pa ngom du bltams te/ dgung lo drug pa lcags mo glang lo la tsā ri trar tshe sgrub mdzad ched du byon pa dang lam du mjal 'bul ba bsnyen bkur gya nom pas 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par mdzad cing*/ chu pho stag gi lo yi dbyar sos/ dpal rtsā ri tra'i gnas kyi bye brag gsar ma las/ bkra shis ljongs su byon/ dpon slob gnas tha dad kyi gz-im khang du bzhugs nas/ tshe dpag tu med pa grub rgyal mo'i lugs kyi phyi nang gsang ba'i bsnyen sgrub mdzad sngags khri phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzlas pas/ mnal lam dang mngon sum gyi ltas khyad par ba yang snang bar gyur cing*/ thugs dam rdzogs rim la mnyam par 'jog pa thun du bcad de gnang sku mtshams de grol ba'i rjes su/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa chu mo yos kyi lo la chos rje karma pa mthong ba don ldan par rab byung mdzad pa dang*/ nyid kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa bzhed pa yang dus de kho na skabs su bab par dgongs te kong po stod dang dwags po nas brgyud de 'ol kha bkra shis thang du sgar pa dpon slob lhan du byon/

mtshal min nas mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams bzang po'i zhal snga nas dgung lo mthon por phebs shing sku lus shin tu lci bar gyur kyang gal che ba la dgongs/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas bka' lung gis lam bar gyis thab 'dzin/ 'do li dar khang can 'degs pa dang*/ dol mda' nas mkhar ltag yan du gtsang gzhung du shan gyis gdan 'dren pa/ sgar pa'i gzhi len thab 'dzin phogs lugs 'ol kha nor bzang la sogs pas sgrub tu bcug cing*/ gdan sa chen po dpal phag mo gru nas chos kyi rje spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas ja 'dren gsol ja zhu ba la/ slob dpon chos sgo ba dman 'dor rgyal po bsod nams dpal dpon slob mang po dang*/ pho brang sne'u gdong nas/ dbang drag bsod nams mtshan can dang*/ slob dpon sog dbon bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ gsang ste ston pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dge slong bcu'i tshogs su bsnyen par rdzogs par mnos so// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa 'drem dkyil la brten nas dbang bdun gong ma gong ma chen po/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag dbang dang*/ tshe dpag grub rgyal ma'i dbang la sogs pa gsan/ mkhan chen rin po che sku 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad/ dpon slob thugs dgyes spro dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ klong la nas phyir byon nas dwags lha sgam po'i gdan sar phebs/ sku 'dra rin po che la mchod pa mang skol mdzad de/ kong por rim pas byon te ba yo dgon dang nye ba dgon sar rgya mtsho sgang du re zhig bzhugs nas/ sog dbon bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ ston grags kyi mtshan gzhan rig pa'i ral gri zhes pa'i drung du/ thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho kun las btus su grags pa'i rjes gnang dang lung*/ byams pa'i chos lnga/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ rtsod bzlog

/rig pa drug cu pa/ zhib mo rnam 'thag /stong nyid bdun bcu pa rnams dang*/ bstod tshogs kyang gsan zhing*/ thos bsam sgom pa la gcig tu brtson par bzhugs/ slob ma 'ga' zhig la zhal gdams kyang gnang*/ de nas dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun ba chu pho byi ba'i lo la chos rje karma pa mthong ba don ldan pa dang*/ dpon slob lhan du dbus phyogs su pheb pa legs pa'i bka' gros mthun nas nyang kha lung pa nas brag gsum gyen la brgal te 'jam ne dang dmar tsha thud rdor a rig thang nas rim gyis sgom sde dang sog gi bar du byon/ dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis rta khrab mdzo pho mo sogs 'bul ba rgya cher byung zhing*/ dgos su nag shod nas chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i zhal slob bla ma dkar po rin bzang zhes bya ba phrin las che bar snang bas gdan drangs/ sbud mda' dang grib dong la sogs par byon khrom chos dang so so'i 'dun pa dang mthun pa'i chos gnang*/ bla ma rin bzang pa de sgrub po yon tan dang ldan par dgongs te/ chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i skyes rabs gser phreng*/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor cha lag tshang ma/ rtogs ldan rin po che grags pa seng ge'i rnam thar gnyis/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyi gsungs 'bum la sogs pa'i lung gsan/ bla ma de nyid kyis thog drangs mtshungs med bla ma dam pa rnams la thugs kyi dad pa stobs su gyur ba 'khrungs nas bstod pa yang mdzad/ de nas byang rgyud kyi gzhung lam ji lta bar rim pas phebs shing*/ 'dam gzhung du bla ma rin po che ban sgar ba 'jam dpal bzang pos mjal te/ nā ro chos drug dang*/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor zhus pas dgyes bzhin du gnang*/ rong po chen po la sogs pas 'bul pa yang mang du byas/ chu mo glang gi lo la stod lung mtshur phu'i dgon par thog mar phebs/ dpon slob so sos mang ja 'gyed dang bcas pa gnang*/ gnas nang rgyal ba'i ri khrod du/

bla ma bsod nams 'bum dang*/ bla ma grags pa 'od zer pa slob dpon rin po che bla ma rgyal mtshan pas thog drangs 'dus pa rnams la/ dpal dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu sgam po pa'i bka' 'bum tshang ma'i lung sogs/ chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshim par mdzad cing*/ nas 'bul ba byung ba rnams gnyer ba dang bcas nas rgyun bzhag pas/ phyi rabs kyi bar du'ang phan pa'i mthun rkyen du gyur/ mtshur phur bla ma gangs pa dbang phyug mtshan zhes pa la ni gu chos drug gi dbang byin rlabs lung khrid tshang ba/ chos skyong gi skor dang bcas pa dang*/ bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum bka' rgya ma sogs rdzogs pa/ dmangs do ha'i rnam bshad gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rnams gsan/ bla ma 'di nyid la gsan pa'i tshe sgrub zab mo'i gsung rgyun ji lta ba zin bris 'debs pa gnang*/ lha sa 'phrul snang dang*/ ra mo che gung thang rnams mjal ba la'ang dpon slob lhan du phebs/ mchod 'bul smon lam 'debs pa mdzad/ gzhes kha sne'u rdzong pa phag gru dbon pos spyi sgos kyi gzhi len 'bul ba byas/ chos rje rin po che karma pa mthong ba don ldan mtshur phur bzhugs yun cung zad yod pa yong ba 'dra ba dang*/ snam 'bar gu shrī la sogs pa'i go nad sna tshogs 'char ba dgongs nas/ skyi shod nas dbur ston du brgyud nyang po long po nas kong por sngon la byon/ dga' ldan ma mor mtshur ston chos kyi rje rin chen pa'i drung nas gdan drangs te/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rdul chon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs pa dang*/ dril bu lha lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil la sogs pa'i dbang rjes gnang mang po dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i khrid/ zab mo nang don/ brtag gnyis kun spyod rnams kyi bshad lung*/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyi'i chos 'byung*/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag /rgyal sras thogs med pa'i bka' 'bum/

dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skor gyi lung rnams gsan/ de nas chos rje karma pa'ang nyang kha nas rim pas phebs yod pa gsan nas ja zhus bsu ba la byon/ stag rtser yab yum gnyis kyi gson dge la dmigs nas 'gyed chen gtong ba'i gral dbu la spyan drangs/ rten gsum gser dngul gos dar rta khrab kyi 'bul ba dgu tshan mang po dang*/ rab byung pho mo brgya phrag bcur nye ba dang*/ skye bo pho mo khri phrag du long tsam la tshwa mar gyi 'gyed/ sgar dpon rnams dang*/ dgon so so'i bla ma rnams la rnam gzhag bzang po grub pa'i rjes su/ stag rtse'i gling gseb kyi gnas khang zhig tu/ khams pa po to dgon pa'i bla ma ye shes dbang po na ba'i sar/ nad dris mdzad pa la mdzo yu chen po yod pa chibs te bug sgo 'dra ba'i sgo dog po la ma 'thog par nang du byon/ khams dri mdzad nas phyir sngar ltar mdzo yu chibs nas byon pa na/ bla ma rdza dgon kun spangs pa'i nye gnas sogs kyis rtog dpyod zhugs te the tshom zos nas mdzo yul chibs sga gtod pa khrid 'ongs pas bug sgo lta bu de'i ya them la sor bzhi lhag tsam ma reg pa las mi 'dug pa mthong ba thams cad 'di 'dra ba'i rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i bla ma yod ces dad pa dang mig 'phrul dang mtshungs pa'i blo skyes nas ya mtshan du bzung ngo*// de nas chos kyi rje rin po che karma pa'i drung du/ rdo rje bdag med ma lha dgu /gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa rdul tshon la brten pa'i dbang sogs dang*/ rjes gnang du ma/ gzhan yang lung dang gdams pa phran bu ci rigs pa phul/ tshur yang rje nyid kyi gsung sgros skor dang*/ bslab pa kun btus la sogs pa'i lung zhus te/ zab cing rgya che ba'i thugs 'brel mdzad/ sgar chen mdo khams phyogs kyi grwa slob mi chen du mas gdan drangs nas phyags thegs khar/ ba yo'i dgon ma lag dang bcas pas thog drangs kong phyogs kyi bstan pa'i gtad gnyer phyi bzhag yang dag pa mdzad cing*/

chibs drel mang po'i rdzong ba skyel thang yang gnang*/ rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i zhal slob mkhan chen lhag ru pa shākya grags pa la/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos/ 'brug pa'i khrid chen brgyad/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa/ a ro snyan brgyud/ zhi byed so lugs/ o rgyan pa'i gsung 'bum/ rgod tshang pa'i gsung sgros rnams dang*/ o rgyan pa'i phreng skor mgur 'bum rnam thar/ thugs rje chen po mi tra'i chos skor/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ trag shad kyi sgrub skor mang po dang*/ lce sgom rdzong bas mdzad pa'i chos skor ci rigs sogs gsan/ dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsug lag khang rnying pa sra mi thub par gsar bzhengs bzhed pas/ rngo gsog skabs nyid byon te rdo gter chen po phyung*/ las mi sogs par nyin bzhin chos thun re yang gsungs/ nyer 'tshe cung zad tsam yang med par thog gcig grub/ spu po phyogs kyis grwa slob rnams kyi gdan 'dren ngor phyags pheb nas smin grol la bkod/ slar thog gnyis pa bcas grub nas steng shod kyi ri mo shing rtsi bsgrub tshe/ lha bzo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i yi dwags kyi nyer 'tshe byung ba la bskrad pa'i sbyor ba mdzad pas/ dngos su mi bzod pa'i skad ngan sgrogs pa byung zhing gtor ma gnang bas gzhan yang gnod sbyin gyis zin pa dag zhi zhing phyis nas gnod pa med cing thams cad khams bde bar byung ba'i lo rgyus mang du snang ngo*//

dus der stag lung chos rje kun spangs pa byang chub rgya mtsho dpon slob brgya skor phebs par/ thugs nang gcig pa'i gnang legs dang*/ mkha' spyod pa'i bka' 'bum tshang ma'i lung dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho pad+ma zab rgyas/ phag mo lha so bdun ma dang lha lnga/ ber gyi dbang bzhi dang rjes gnang sogs dbang dang bka' chos kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ tshur yang stag lung thang pa chen pos mdzad pa'i chos drug yid bzhin nor bu/ chos rje bkra shis dpal brtsegs pas mdzad pa'i 'od dkar phreng ba sogs kyi lung gsan/ zla ba gsum lhag gi bar du bzhugs pa'i phog gung tshigs nar mar 'dren pa zur gsos bzang bsham bstar chags pa dang*/ shangs len dang rdzong pa'i 'bul ba dpang mtho ba mdzad cing*/ kong lung ral gsum gyis gtsos tshogs pa rnams la/ nged rang dang khyad med pa dang dung khur 'bul ba dang*/ dad 'bul so so'i blo dang bstun pa gyis gsung ba'i bka' shog mgron gnyer pa tshe dbang rgyal dpon g.yog phyags phyir mgo lung la gnang*/ shing pho byi ba'i lo gsar du shar ba'i tshes grangs gza' skar byed sbyor bzang po la/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun rnams kyis dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i rab tu gnas pa dga' ston rgya chen po dang bcas pa grub/ bzo rigs do dam pa rnams la gtong rag rdzong pa mdzad de dbus phyogs du brdzangs/ me mo glang gi lo la kong lung ral gsum thams cad du me tog la phebs pa'i tshe/ yul so so'i sngar srol dang mthun pa'i sgo zho/ rang rang gi 'byor ba dang mtshams pa'i bsnyen bkur 'bul ba byas shing*/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje dang*/ drung mkha' spyod dbang po/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis chos rgya mdzad pa bzhin du rgya yun ring ba mdzad na/ nged kong po thams cad la bka' drin che ba 'dug /phyag rdzas dngos po la phongs pa ni gnang mi dgos/

de'i steng nas khral 'u lag rgya 'og tu ma tshud pa rnams dmag gis bcun na gun so ba yong zhes gtso bo drag tshad kyis ngos dang brgyud nas zhu ba la/ ngas dngos po la phongs pa min zhing*/ khal 'u lag dmag gis thams cad sdug 'jug pa'i shes 'dod med srol bstar chags kyi me tog /rta chag sogs bsdu ba dang*/ 'u lag rang gi dgon chung dang khral 'jal gyis chog pa yod/ khrims bsdoms pas yon bdag rtsa ba tshos nye ba'i bsnyems pa byas nas 'gal ba byed/ de la rtsad gcod drag po byas dus bka' nad byung gis dogs/ 'on kyang khyed thams cad kha mthun par zer na lo gsum gyi bar rgya byed pa yin mod/ gsungs nas zhal gyis bzhes/ de'i 'di skabs tshor ba yo'i gzim khang gi zhig gsos/ yo dam gyi khang pa brtsigs pa sogs ba yo ri dgon gyi 'dzin skyong sngar las lhag pa/ bla ma'i zhabs tog kho na la dmigs te mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa lcags pho stag gi lo gsar mtshams su kong lung ral gsum gyi gtso bo phal cher mar steng du bsags nas rgya snga ma'i rjes kyi mi sha chags pa kha mchu che ba thug pa/ nor dngos po shor god cher byung ba rnams la/ snying non god gsub kyi ched du rta phyugs stobs che ba'i gnang sbyin mdzad/ lo gsum gyi ring la 'thab rtsod rkun jag med cing ri rgya klung rgya/ bu lon la bsnyad pa'i gtes nang len sogs byung na chad pa yod pa'i khrims yig chen mo bcos/ rgya'i gung dpon gnyis khrims gcod yul so so'i blo chad rnams bskos gna' bsgags shing khṛms 'gal du gte bsdus sa mtshams kyang chims mi lung pa'i ngang la phyin rgya la yan/ nyang kha'i shu gying man nyin lam bcu gnyis tsam yod pa thams cad rgya 'og tu bcug /de'i khongs su ma gtogs pa'i nyang kha stod pa brag lung nyang gsum la mi gnod pa'i khrims kyang mdzad pas/ yul khams bde skyid lo legs nad med pa dang ldan par gyur/

sa pho 'brug gi lo la dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsug lag khang gi span bad btang*/ dwags po'i grwa slob kyis phul ba'i gser 'phru yang btsugs/ lcags mo lug gi lo'i ston mjug / sku rabs sku mched kyis gdan drangs/ 'bru mda' dang*/ sku rabs su byon/ sbyin bdag rnams kyis 'bul ba zhabs tog byas shing*/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod kyi bgo bsha' yang mdzad dus 'dir/ thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzang rtse ba tsā ri skor ba la phebs pa dang dus mtshungs su byung nas sku mdun du mjal/ zhabs mthil gyi ri mo hor yig gsar gyi rgyal zhes pa'i ngos 'dzin yang zhus shing*/ chos drug chen mo dang*/ dam tshig rgya mtsho'i lung gsan/ dpon slob bsten yun thung yang*/ thugs shin tu nye ba gus ba dang ldan pa'i zhal slob kyi mchog tu gyur/ slar yang dga' ldan ma mor byon te/ btsun pa btsun dbang thob pa sum brgya tsam la rgyud 'bum gyi lung mdzad pa'i skabs su/ lung zhu ba rnams kyis rgyun mchod byas shing nyer 'tshe dang bral bas gnyan cha yang ma byung zhing chab dkar gyi ri khrod dge 'dun sgang du bzhugs pa na/ rnam rtog chos sku'i yin tshul gyi mgur yang mdzad/ da nas rgya lo gsum gyi zla ba 'ga' zhig ma thams pa'i skabs su chab dkar gyi nang du mi gces pa zhig bsad pa'i rgya 'ga' byung ba la rgya dpon gnyer pa rnams kyis chad pa gcod pa tsam gyis mi tshangs pas/ dmag gis sdigs pa'i 'jun lugs 'thad zhu ba la 'khrug pa zhi ba'i thabs su rgya byas nas dmag byed pa ban de'i bya bar mi 'gro bas/ ro rtsa la babs chug la stang sprod len gyis/ nged kyis chad pa'i dong du ban dmag bsdus nas gtor ma rgyag pa yin gsungs/ kar srid rnams la go cha lag cha gtan nas mi dgos/ phyar dar rol cha sbra cha ther thams cad khyer shog ces pa'i bka' shog bkram/ mon snying tshal du sgar btab te bskang gso'i rgyun dang thun gtor mdzad nas babs kyi zhu ba ma tshud pa/

'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang zlog pa'i rnam pa dang*/ bsam chung 'ga' zhig gis ban de kha yar bsad pa'i ched du mda' gzhu khyer te gru chung la brten nas 'ongs pa'i gzhu 'od ma chags cing chu la shor nas ngan sems rang sar yal zhing*/ thal gtor g.yab mo'i zlog pa byed pa rnams la'ang 'phral du mi rung ba byung*/ khyad par gtsang po yang rgyun phyogs las 'gyur te grong gi nye logs kyi zhing dang ra ba sogs khyer ba dang*/ rlung 'tshub chen po khang pa g.yo ba dang tsam lan mang du grong de nyid kho nar 'khor bas 'gyod cing skrag dngangs che bar byed pa ltar/ mi gces pa rnams 'phral du shi ba sogs bkra mi shis pa'i rnam pa du ma rgyun du byung ngo*/ /ban dmag gyes nas mar steng du byon te/ dgu gtor dang 'grig pa zhig gi tshe dar nag cig rlung gis bskyod de/ sgo lcog gi steng du shor ba yun ring du bzung mkhan med kyang 'greng ba mngon sum du mthong ba rnams skyi bung zhes byed pa'i zil dang*/ cho 'phrul chen po byung skabs der zhing skyong gi spyan 'dren bstod bskul yang rtsom par mdzad/ yang skabs zhig dung mod pa la chos skyong rbad pas/ sprul pa'i tshogs kyis grong thams cad khengs pa sogs/ drag po'i phrin las kyis skye bo mang po btul lo// rkyen phu lung gsum gyis sgo gong 'og ma 'chams pa la nor rdzas mang du gnang ste/ dus phyi rabs kyi bar du gtan 'jags bka' drin che ba mdzad/ sku mdun du blo gtad zhus pa'i tshan ci rigs kyis bsam ngan skyes pa la/ chos skyong bskul ba med kyang*/ zhing skyong gi cho 'phrul mngon sum du mthong nas de dag tshe'i dus 'phral du byas pa sogs 'dir ma smos pa gzhan yang mang rab 'byung bas chos skyong gis bka' nyan cing las byed par 'dug go zhes gus pa dang mi ldan pa rnams kyang yid ches rgyun du gnag phyugs kyi rdzis mgo skyong ba/ rta lhing ma'i khyu 'jog pa/

phyag nas kyi 'bun gtong len sogs 'jig rten pa dang sgo btun nas mdzad pa ltar yod kyang*/ thugs dam bskyed rdzogs khrigs su bcad pa las mi g.yel ba dang*/ sku gzugs phyag dpe bzhengs pa bla ma dang dkon mchog gi mchod pa ltar chags dang dus dus su mdzad pa/ grwa pa sbyin bdag skyong ba'i thabs ky-is yo lang 'khrugs bsdums rnams kyang phan pa'i dgongs pa ma gtogs rang 'dod phug bcug gi sel dang*/ ngan thabs kyis gzhan la gnod pa la ci mi snyam par mnga' 'og tu 'jug pa'i sbyor ba mi gnang bas thams cad yid rton du rung ba'i gnas su bzung zhing*/ thugs dang ma mthun pa la'ang dmag khyer btson 'dzin sogs ma mdzad kyang mi rung ba'i chad pa chos skyong gis bcad pas ljing non che bas thams cad chud pa yin no// nges 'byung gi thugs dang ldan pas/ bla ma gong ma gnyis kyi rnam thar ltar/ chos bshad sgrub la brtson pas rang gzhan gyis don sgrub par 'dod kyang*/ 'jig rten blos ma theng bas de ltar ma byung yang yang gsungs/ de'i skabs shig tu/ chos rje dbu ri ba chos kyi dbang phyug ces bya ba dwags kong rnams su phrin las dang ldan pa byung bas kyang mjal zhing chos kyi 'brel ba zhus/ tsā ri rin phug gi dgon pa btab nas rjes su phyag tu 'bul bar zhus ba'i rten 'brel gyis dus phyis dgon pa ma lag thams cad nged pa la 'bul ba 'byung*/ de nas dga' ldan ma mor sku mtshams thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i zla ba 'ga' shas song ba'i dus su chos rje mthong ba don ldan pa bom 'bor sgang che chung dang*/ rab sgang yan gdul bya'i don mdzad nas zur mang dang karma dgon du phebs nas/ gzim khang rtsig pa'i skabs shig tu sku khams ma snyoms pa rgyun ring ba byung ba'i skad cha rim pas gsan pa la/ zhu yig khyer ba'i bong chen rkang btsugs su btang ba'i zhu len 'khor byung bas thugs kyis ma bzod par kong por gdan drangs te bzhugs na 'thad pa'i dgongs pa shar te/

sa mo sbrul gyi lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bdun la dga' ldan ma mo nas bteg /brag gsum nas dmar tsha thung dang bzhed rog la sogs pa'i lho stod smad du/ rdza dgon pa'i gdan sa pa dang*/ rgya ston blo bzang grags pa/ rgya ston ngag dbang*/ grags pa khu dbon sbo to bla ma rgyal mtshan seng ge la sogs pas 'bul ba zhabs tog byas/ chos kyi 'brel ba zhus shing lam par gyi skya ser byings kyis kyang gus pas btud de/ ri bo che'i dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang mjal/ nag tshang chen mor mkhan slob sgom pa ma chen sogs kyis gzhi len bzang du zhus*/ chos rje mi g.yo mgon po dang mjal phrad spyi pas mngon du gyur ba ni ma byung na'ang rnam pa gnyis spyan 'dren pa'i mjal ba dang*/ ngo mkhyen res byung ba yin zhes gzhi byes kha cig smra'o// de nas ngom chu 'gram du mkhan chen rtsod kyam gu'i shri'i zhal snga nas kyis gtso mdzad/ sgar dpon rnam pas bsu ba mdzad cing*/ dpal karma'i gdan sa chen por dpon slob zhal mngon du mjal/ sku skyos bsnyel dwangs kyi 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ gzhi len gnang sbyin yang mdzad/ zla ba 'ga' zhig gi bar du bzhugs pa'i dus/ grub chen karma pa'i rigs kyi dbon brgyud/ dus phyis drung si tu rin po che bar grags pa de nyid kyis chos lung mang du zhus shing dad mos shin tu che bar gyur la 'brong bu gu shrī grags blo bas/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung ci rigs zhus/ gdong sgam po pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis kyang dbang bka' rjes gnang lung mang rab zhus shing*/ lho la yag pas mdzad pa'i dwags po'i chos bzhi rtsa 'grel sogs lung dkon pa kha yar de nyid las phar yang gsan zhing chos 'brel zab mo dang ldan no// skabs zhig bar chad rtsom pa'i mtshan ma gzigs te/ de 'dul ba'i bskrad pa drag po mdzad pas/ chos rje mthong ba don ldan pa sku khams legs bar dngas nas yor mdar byon/

rim gyi kong por phyags 'degs pa'i snga 'gros pa brdzangs/ thugs thag bcad nas lha steng du byon pa na rab byung bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba mang po'i mkhan por gsol ba btab pas 'gro ba mi legs pa 'dug gsungs pa'i zhal ta yang yang mdzad kyang nan gyis zhus nas byon te rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi cho ga tshar zhing 'bul ba grub rjes sku grib kyis blo bur du bsnyel ba byung ba la/ thams cad bred par gyur zhing*/ sku rim mang du sgrub pa dang*/ lhag par thugs dam kyi mthus sol myur ba byung*/ slar yor mda' zhes par bzhugs dus sngags pa zhig gis sku rim nus pa yod pa'i bsnyen pa drag po byas pas/ de'i mtshan mo shi ba'i rjes su sku khams bde skyed che ba byung nas/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis ky-is sa cha brgyud de byon pa la/ nang chen tshang gsar ba'i dge bshes so sos 'bul ba zhabs tog byas shing*/ chos lugs dang sku skyos gang rgyas kyis gdab lan yang gnang*/ khyung pho gser ris g.yu ris phyogs su lam gtod do/ /lho rong du nang so kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi phar tshur phebs lam gyi zhabs tog yang dag bsgrubs/ chos kyi rje karma pa'i sgar yang de'i rjes su rim pas bteg nas gdul bar bya ba'i bla dpon rnams gtso bor gyur ba'i ban skya mtha' dag gis bsnyen bkur dang du bzhes bzhin du+u bshul ji lta bar phebs/ dgun gyi dus klo lam dkar nag nas snga phyir byon pa'i dpon slob bsu pa'i 'u lag dang bcas pa la nyer 'tshe phra mo tsam yang med par kong por phebs/ rim gyis stag rtse dang dga' ldan ma mor byon nas bzhuḍa/ lcags pho rta lo'i dbyar/ chos grwa chen po rtse thang nas/ chos kyi rje nam mkha' blo gros dpon slob rnams mjal du byon pa la gsung chos mdor bsdus bzhed pa dang sbyar ba gnang bas/ zhal slob kyi gtso bo gcig tu gyur/ thugs gus pa dang ldan pas dbon po smon lam rdo rje pa'i yi ge klog slob pa yang mdzad do//

chos rje karma pa'ang dga' ldan ma mo la sogs par phebs/ gzhi len 'bul ba rgya cher phul te phyir bteg nas rtse bla sgang dang gsa' phu'i gnas kyi bar du rim gyis bzhugs/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i sku khams kyang bde mi bde res 'jog yod pa byung bas/ sku rim sngags rgyun gsung sgrogs bskang gso rgyun du btsugs pas/ lcags mo lug nas sku khams cung zad bde skyed yod pa dang*/ gal che ba'i grwa slob yon bdag rnams dang mjal zhing*/ bsnyel dngos 'bul ba yul dgon so sos phul ba'ang bzhes/ nged rang gi blo 'dod ma tshim pa med pas sems bde ba yin gsungs/ bslab bya gang dgos so so la gnang*/ rtogs ldan bsam grags/ rtogs ldan chos bzang*/ dge bshes kun rgyal/ bla ma rgya 'dem/ dge bshes blo gros mgon po la sogs pa dam tshig dang ldan pa'i zhal slob dang/ gsol gzim sogs nye gnas nyung 'dus ma gtogs/ dpon gsol ja pa pad+ma bsam 'grub dang*/ gnyer chen grags pa gzhon nu'i thogs drangs gnyer las 'dzin rnams 'brel ba gcod pa dang*/ so so'i gzhi la brdzangs nas sku mtshams dam pa dang*/ thugs dam rdzogs pa'i rim pa zab mo sgom pa'i khrigs su bcad pa la bzhugs/ sku mdun pa rnams kyang sku rim gsol 'debs la brtson par gnas pa'i skabs su/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba rnams kyi byed spyod la skyo ba skyes nas mgur mdzad/ de ltar dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe drug yan du/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas gdul bar bya ba'i don rgya cher mdzad pa las/ 'gro ba du ma'i mgon skyabs bla ma'i bla ma lta bur gyur pa/ chos rje karma pa mthong ba don ldan gyi zhal snga nas dang*/ stag lung chos rje kun spangs byang chub rgya mtsho ba la/ bka' lung gdams pa 'bul bar mdzad cing*/ mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu dang*/ mi chen du mas kyang zhabs la gtugs shing*/ chos gsan pas zhal slob kyang dbus dang khams phyogs su byon pa du ma'i nang nas/

khyad par du 'phags pa rnams ni/ bla ma rin po 'jam dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen gu shrī dpal 'byor don grub/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal/ chos kyi rje nam mkha' blo gros/ karma si tu rin po che/ 'brong bu grags blo ba/ gnas nang gdan sa pa grags pa 'od zer/ slob dpon rin po che bla ma rgyal mtshan pa/ chos rje dbu ri ba chos kyi dbang phyug /rgya ston ngag dbang grags pa/ spo to ba rgyal mtshan seng ge /phu lung dgon thog karma pa bsod nams lhun po/ rtogs ldan chos kyi bzang po la sogs pa'i phrin las phyogs mthar skyong ba mang po dang*/ lho rong nang so kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis sogs mi chen mang po'ang zab rgyas chos kyis 'brel ba'i rnam dkar bzang por sbyong ba la sogs pa mdzad pa phal cher mthar phyin te/ dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bdun pa chu pho sprel lo gsar pa nas/ nam mkha' yongs su dag pa las/ me tog gi char kha dog sna tshogs pa nyin re bzhin 'bab pa phal cher mi zin zhing*/ cung zad zin pa rnams mod la yar 'gro ba dang*/ khyad par nam mkha' 'thib pa'i dus kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa dang nor ba'i me tog dkar shas che ba'i char zha la'i steng du phyags rgyu yod dam snyam pa bar ma chad par babs pas/ drung du 'khod pa rnams dad gus ya mtshan gyi blo dang*/ sku khams mi 'tsho ba'i ltas yin nam snyam du bred pa'i rnam pa sems the tshom skye ba byung*/ chos rje mthong ba don ldan pa'i drung nas yar 'phrod rtag tu gnang ba dang*/ phyir zhu 'phrod rgyun chags su 'bul zhing yod pa la/ rtogs ldan bsam grags pa la sogs pas zhu ngag the tshom skyes tshul 'phul bas/ nged dpon slob gnyis ka yun du mi 'tsho ba dang*/ bye brag tu de nas sngon la gshegs pa'i ltas yin gsung ba byung zhes gsol ja ba ye shes dpal la sogs pa'i ngag las thos so//

de nas dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams kyis brtan bzhugs yang yang phul na'ang*/ thugs sna thung ba'i zhal ta ma gtogs zhal bzhes gang yang ma grub cing*/ ston zla ra ba zhes kong po'i grong rtsis pa rnams kyis tha snyad du byed pa zla ba lnga pa shar nas/ thugs dam gyi rten rnams dbu sngas su spyan drangs te/ mchod pa rgyas pa byed du bcug nas/ gsung ngag bcad de phal cher thugs dam kho na gnang*/ tshes gsum la dbon po shākya dbang phyug dang*/ gnyer chen grags pa gzhon nu'i thogs drangs la/ nged rang la 'das pa'i rjes su dgongs rdzogs byed lugs 'diltar gyis/ gtso bor chos rje rin po che'i dgongs pa len dgos pa sogs/ zhib rgyas kyi zhal ta mang du mdzad pa'i skabs su/ dbon po shākya dbang phyug gis nyid bzhugs par gsol ba m-i thebs na/ sprul sku 'byung ba'i sa cha'i ming gsal bar zhu zhes yang yang zhus pas/ trer 'ong gsungs shes bla ma shākya dbang phyug zer ro/ /tshes bzhi'i nyi ma shar mtshams su/ rje btsun sgrol ma dang*/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa byon/ mchod rdzas shoms shig ces lan mang du gsungs pa'i 'phrol/ gnyer chen grags pa gzhon nus sku brten pa las/ seṅge'i nyal stabs su mdzad de/ zhi ba'i dbyings su snyoms par zhugs so// de dang mtshungs par 'ja' tshon dkar po dar thag brkyang ba 'dra ba sba la kha nas glang bu'i ri'i bar la 'brel ba'i/ yal ga'i sna gcig gzim khang la yun ring du thug pa/ sum mkhar yul pa phal mo che dang*/ dga' ldan ma mo ba rnams kyis mthong ngo*/ /de'i mod la bzhugs pa'i steng du gdan drangs te/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ dbu rgyan zhus/ mchod pa'i bkod pa rgyas pa bshams te/ zhal slob rnams kyis gsol ba zhag zhe dgu'i bar du btab pa'i tshe'ang*/ lha'i me tog gi char nyin re bzhin bab pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od kyi dra pas bar snang khyab pa yul mi thams cad kyis mthong ba dang*/

skabs 'gar nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru'i sgra gsal po grags pa/ nye bar gnas pa rnams kyis thos so/ /gsol dpon pad+ma bsam grub dang*/ gnyer chen grags pa gzhon nus thogs drangs rnams kyis/ chos kyi rje karma pa mthong ba don ldan pa'i drung du 'bul ba/ sgar pa'i gu shrī dang dpon rnam pa mi mang dang bcas pa la/ rnam bzhag dang 'gyed/ kong lung ral gsum gyi kar srid gtso bor gyur ba'i dgon pa thams cad kyi bla ma rnams la rnam bzhag /grwa pa rnams la 'gyed/ sum mkhar du skya ser stong phrag mang po la/ nag ston bzang bshams yod pa grub cing*/ chos kyi rje mthong ba don ldan gyi bka' bkod ji ltar pheb pa bzhin/ sku gdung ril por dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsug lag khang du/ byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi bre dang bum pa'i mtshams su bzhugs shing*/ nang rten byang chub chen po'i gser sku/ dbus kyi sa cha skyid shod 'phrang khar bzhengs te/ dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs rab tu gnas pa dga' ston dang bcas pa grub cing*/ dus kyi mchod pa rgyun ldan yang btsugs so// ༈¿¿ngom pa bya bral ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni/ mdo khams ngom gyi yul du lha ldong dkar po'i rgyud las/ dpon chen rgyal bzang po sogs/ sa skya pa'i phrin las 'dzin zhing*/ du dben sha'i las ka rim par bzung ba'i brgyud nang pa rgyal bzang zhes grags pa'i sras te/ lcags pho khyi'i lo la sku 'khrungs shing*/ 'khrungs ma thag nas sku rim pa'i bla ma rnams kyis gser gyi mchod rten dang*/ me dpung du mthong ba'ang byung*/ lo bzhi nas ri bo cher slob gnyer mdzad/ lo drug pa'i dus bya rog gdong can zhal gzigs/ lo dgu pa'i dus ri khrod du byon te/ gcod yul gyi nyams len mdzad pa'i tshe/ yum chen mo dang*/ ma gcig lab sgron/ pha dam pa soḍa mang po'i zhal gziḍa/ bla ma sangs rgyas pa la ni gu'i skor gsan pas/ rmi lam sprul bsgyur zhing sbyaung sogs la tshegs med cing*/

rmi lam dang mngon sum khyad med pa byung*/ gnas luḍa kyi rtogs pa'ang mngon du gyur nas chu'i bcud len yang mdzad/ de nas bya bral mdzad par dgongs te/ chos bros la byon kyang*/ khyung tho lar ma thar nas tshur ldog pa'i tshe/ gzhis na len mkhan btang ba rnams 'byor pas dbang med du khyim du byon/ yab yum gyi gsung gis khyim thabs kyi tshul mi byed ka med du gyur/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo brgyad pa dang mjal ba'i tshe/ byang chen mchod rten bum nang du thub sku me long du gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba zhig bud med rus rgyan can zhig gis/ khyod rang gi lha skal gyis zer nas gtad pa rmis/ yang rmi lam du chos rje rin po ches zhabs mgo la bkod nas/ khyod ni las dang skal bar ldan// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'jug/ dbang bzhi'i don la mi rmongs shing*// nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ snying nang du chos rje bzhugs nas ngo sprod kyi brda' bstan pa sogs byung bas/ gnas lugs la nges shes khyad par can rnyed/ smar khams su byon skabs zhig rbab chen po byung ba sdig mdzub gtad pas 'thor ba dang*/ zla stod du pha wang zhig gi ser kar phyag mdzub gtad de/ 'dir nga'i slob dpon gyi slob ma grong chog pa zhig yod pa 'dren dgos gsungs nas/ rdo kha phyes pa'i bar du srog chags na bun bu mo 'dra ba la mi'i kha sna dod pa zhig byung bar gzungs sngags brjod cing byin rlabs mdzad pas gar song cha med du gyur ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa du ma bstan/ bla ma dkon mchog dpal la mkha' 'gro snying thig zhus skabs 'od gsal gyi 'char sgo 'byams klas pa dang*/ phyag mchod kyi ka pā la'i steng na dbus su dus 'khor/ mdun du bde mchog /g.yas su kye rdor/ g.yon du 'jigs byed/ rgyab tu mā yā rnams kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gzigs/ bla ma sangs rgyas pa la bi ma snying thig zhus skabs/

ter pe dang*/ re yam kyi ri gnyis skyil krung gis khyab pa'i rnam snang zhal gzigs/ gzhan yang so so nas bshad pa'i yon tan thams cad brnyes/ de skabs zhig tu yab yum gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su rten bzhengs mang po dang*/ 'tshogs pa khri phrag gsum tsam 'dus pa'i shid ston chen mo mdzad/ gral dbur si tu bkra shis rgyal mtshan pa sogs bla ma mang du spyan drangs/ 'bul 'gyed blos mi 'khyud pa lta bu mdzad/ de nas sde sred gzhan la sprad nas/ nyid khyim nas rab tu byung ba dang*/ yab yum gyi dge rtsa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dngos po stobs chen bsnams nas dbus su byon/ jo bo rin po che'i drung du gser kong gcig /dngul kong gnyis/ kong rgyag dang bcas pa btsugs/ gser chab lan mang du gsol/ bal yul 'phags pa shing kun la gser gdugs phul/ gsang bde mtshur gsum sogs sa skya man chad du dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed dang*/ bla ma bzang dgu la 'bul ba mdzad/ zhabs phyi rnams phyir bzlog nas nyid tshogs chen po'i mkhan po rgyal dbang las rab tu byung ba dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dngos bor bsgrubs/ spyir dus snga phyi nges med du+u sa bzang 'phags pa/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/ chos rje kun bkras pa/ blo gsal ba/ sga ru ba/ rgya ma ba/ karma dkon gzhon/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal/ 'ug pa lung gi bla chen khu dbon/ gnas rnying mkhan chen/ chos rje nyi bzang ba/ blo gros dpal ba/ btsong kha ba/ spyan snga bsod grags/ skyes mchog rin bzang*/ 'bri khung dharma rā dza/ chos rje dpal bzang ba/ pan chen shā ri pu+u tra/ karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ mtshur bu'i slob dpon chen po/ mkhan chen mgo blon pa/ rtogs ldan shākya 'od/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ dgra bcom yon tan blo gros/ chos rje byams chos pa/ phag gru'i spyan snga bsod nams dpal/ nad pa yon tan dpal/ shing mgo rin po che/ dbu ma pa/ go shrī don grub 'od zer/

si tu chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa rat+na shrī/ rin po che rat+nā ka ra/ mdzo ra ba/ mgon po rgyal mtshan/ bka' bcu dar ma rin chen/ rong stong bka' bcu pa/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar pa/ yon rin pa/ blo gros yangs pa/ zhwa dmar mkha' spyod dbang po sogs gtsang dbus khams gsum gyi bla ma mchog gyur brgya dang sum bcu bsten cing*/ de dag las dbang khrid gdams ngag mtha' klas par nod par mdzad kyang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ni chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa nyid la mdzad cing thabs lam rtsa rlung gi yon tan mtha' dag ni rje yon rin pa dang*/ rtogs ldan mtsho dkar ba las brnyes so// mtsho dkar ba la bsnyen sgrub zhu ba'i tshe/ rlung phyag sor du drang ba dang sran ma'i rdog po shangs nas rngub ste phyag sor du 'don pa sogs byung*/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa las phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa nod pas dngos po'i gnas lugs lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ de nas khams su phebs 'grab rgyal du gzim spyil mdzad nas bzhugs/ lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul mang du byung yang brdzi bar ma nus/ glog mang po 'gyu ba'i tshe rtsed mo'i tshul gyis 'di bzung ngam gsungs/ nye gnas kyis bzung bar zhus pas rdo zhig gis mnan tshul mdzad de glog rengs pas 'od kyis nyin mo ltar gsal ba byung*/ yang rdo de blangs nas btang pa'i tshul mdzad/ rngon pas bdag pa'i khyi dang sha bas skyabs zhus pa dang brag la 'dam ltar brdzi ba sogs rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ rgya nag tu grub chen bir+wa ba'i zhabs 'breng du rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ rgyal pos kyang gus pa byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chags phyi mdzad nas slar bod du phebs te rnam rgyal sgang du chos rje dpon slob lnga brgya spyan drangs zla ba gcig tu chos 'khor bskor/ dge 'dun yang khri phrag tsam 'dus te de dag la zhabs tog mdzad/ chos rje rin po cher dgon sde rnams dang*/

gnas gzhi bco brgyad/ blon po'i bu bco brgyad sogs 'dog pa kun dang ngom gyi sde tshang ma bka' 'bangs su phul lo// re zhig na ngom pa rnams khas btsan cing mnga' thang rgyas par brten/ ma bzod pa'i phrag dog gis ri bo che bas phug byas nas/ da ra ba tshang dang mtha' bzhi zla rngad ngom gsum rong bo dang bcas pa kun bgros nas dmag byas te sa sgang dgon pa bsregs pa sogs byas/ de'i tshe rje 'dis drag po'i spyod pa bstan te/ dmag dang bcas pas de dag thams cad pham par byas nas/ ri bo che pa'ang zhabs su bcug lha khang dang*/ rten gsum yang sngar las lhag par bzhengs shing dar rgyas su mdzad/ 'di dag gi skabs su sku mi snang bar gyur ba dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang lha'i skur mthong ba dang*/ bu chung dang*/ a tsa ra lta bus snang ba sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mang po bstan pa 'bri bar ma langs so// rje de bzhin gshegs pa zhi bar mnal nas sprul ba'i bkod pa dang mjal 'dod drag pos gsol ba btab pa las/ skabs zhig nyi ma 'od zer 'bar ba sku pang du byung ba dang*/ glang po che'i phru gu dkar po zhig gsos pa mnal lam du byung ba'i nang par rnal 'byor pa ma smad gsum pa zhig gzigs pas ltas khyad par ba 'ga' zhig kyang byung*/ byis pa de phag tu khrid nas khyed nga'i bla ma'i sku skye yin nam zhus pas yin gsungs/ yang su yin byas pas/ nga ni skye med brjod pa kun dang bral// gnas med gnas bral 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// ma lus thar pa'i gnas su 'dren pa'i phyir// skye 'gro kun gyi dpal du bdag gyur to// zhes gsungs/ 'o na da gar 'byon zhus pas/ na ma tshar bar yul gzhan mi 'gro 'dug gsungs/ khyed kyi snyan pa bsgrag dgos zhus pas/ ces pa'i tshig de da rung zhag bar gsang dang gsungs yon tan ci mkhyen zhus pas/ a ā/ i ī/ e ai/ u ū/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ zhes gsungs/ der sprul pa'i skur nges pa thob ste zhabs tog yang dag mdzad nas lo drug gi bar du der bzhugs/

de nas sprul pa'i sku sgar chen gyis spyan drangs pa'i tshe lho rong bar du byon/ de nas ma bskungs lung du byon te/ de'i gnas sgo dbye bar dgongs nas ye gong du pheb pa'i tshe 'byung po'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung yang ma tshugs/ mkha' 'gro rnams dang rdo rje'i glus dris lan kyang mdzad/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs gsal bar gzigs/ de nas gnas su gsang nas gshegs pa'i tshe zhing skyong seng gdong ri rab tsam zhig gis seng ge kho rang las chung tsam zhig 'gyed pa dang*/ 'phrang la lcags thag sum sgril gyi snyi 'dzug pa dang*/ mda' rdo'i char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul du ma bstan kyang gnyug ma de bzhin nyid kyi ngang du+u la bzlas pas ma tshugs/ zhag lnga'i bar du mkha' 'gros lam sna byas te gnas rnams gzigs/ lha sku du ma'i zhal phyes/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku zhig spyan drangs gnas bdag ra rgod du brdzus nas byung ba la chos bshad/ nub gcig mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo dpag tu med pa 'dus nas tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ chos rje karma pa dang*/ karma'i kun spangs rin po che dang*/ bka' bzhi pa rnams la tshogs skal 'bul ba gzigs/ drung nyid kyis tshogs de bzhes pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang dbyer med du gyur cing zag med kyi bde bas gang ba'i nyams shar/ de nas ye gong du phebs te gdul bya rnams la chos bstan pa'i tshe nam mkha' la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa dang*/ rdo ba 'dam ltar du brdzi ba sogs rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan/ ha yang dkar po sogs gzhi bdag rnams kyis srog snying phul/ spo bo dar sna dgon du bzhugs tshe dge bshes nam mkha' sogs kyis the tshom gcod pa'i phyir nam mkhar 'phur ba dang*/ rdor dril nam mkhar 'jog pa sogs mdzad/ kha ba dkar du byon pa'i tshe e waṃ na bzhugs dus bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs zhal gzigs/ mkha' 'gro gnas sar du grub chu bton/

de dag tu'ang rdzu 'phrul mang po mdzad/ sngo phun ril sgrub kyi bum pa la phyag nas mdzad pas mang du 'phel/ sdo ma glong bya ba'i mi zhig gis khyed grub thob yin zer bas nga'i khang pa'i ka ba 'di la nas 'bru 'ga' 'dzugs dgos zer bar thugs 'ur nas phyag nas mdzad pas 'bru rnams ka ba la phreng ba ltar bskor nas phyed tsam nub pa byung*/ stag shod kyi khri dpon la mgon po'i gtor dbang mdzad pas nam phyed bya rog gis gtor ma dngos su blangs/ de nas ngom dang spo bo sogs su'ang phebs rten 'brel zhig gis lha sar phebs pa shar bas jo bo dang mjal ba'i tshe ngas gnas lugs kyi don ji bzhin rtogs pa yin na nas 'bru chags par gyur cig /ces nas gtor bas dbu rgyan gyi ngos su nas 'bru lnga tshoms su chags/ jo bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lnga ldan byung ba nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ sne gdong du gong mas spyan drangs shing mchod/ srin po ri'i bde mchog gis mjal dar bzhes pa'i tshul mdzad/ bya bral 'dra ba zhig gis jo bo rje'i thugs ljags spyan gsum 'brel pa rtsa sbubs ring bsrel gyis gang ba'i nang du bde mchog lha tshogs gsal por byon pa thugs la rigs lnga dang sgrol ma'i sa bon rang byon du yod pa zhig phul/ de nas khams su phebs te ngom du jo bo'i sku tshad sogs rten bzhengs 'ga' re'ang mdzad/ de nas kaṃ po gnas nang du phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ nga mi 'chi ba zhig 'ong bar gda' gnas 'di'ang khyad par 'phags pas de tsam zhig 'ong thong gsungs/ chos 'byung steng du gnas phyi nang gi dge bshes mang po la khrid btab/ der rdo la zhabs rjes zhig kyang byon/ mkhar tsar me nyag thar gyi 'bum la rab gnas mdzad pas nas 'bru bdun nam mkha' la chags/ sngo mdo na dbang bskur mdzad sems bskyed gsungs pas nyin gsum du me tog gi char babs/ spangs phug tu rdo gcal gyi gseb nas mkha' spyod ma'i sku rang byon zhig bton/
dbang bskur rab gnas sems bskyed/ bde ba can gyi smon lam rnams gang du mdzad pa'i sar me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar mang po rgyun du 'byung ba snang bas 'bri bar ma langs so//

'brang chung bya ba'i ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sa ra ha zhal gzigs brda'i sgo nas zhu lan mdzad de mthar nyid la thim pa byung*/ de nas glang chen 'gying rir pheb par dgongs nas mi nyag tu byon/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang mjal phrad mdzad/ dar mdo nas brgyud wa wu shan du phebs der mkha' 'gro lnga dang mjal zhing sgyu ma'i rol rtsed mdzad/ 'phags pa sa'i snying pos sku dngos su bstan nas phyag rgya chen po'i khrid stsal/ de nas kan cur phebs/ de nas rim par chin 'du hur phebs/ de ru rgyal bus dkar bya bral ba'i ngag nas grub thob kyi lo rgyus thos pas spyan drangs/ bde mchog dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang sogs gyis rjes su bzungs/ de nas glang chen du byon/ der dgra bcom pa lnga brgya'i khang par pheb pa'i tshe/ g.yas ngos rim bzhin brtsis nas byon pas drug cu re bzhi'i mtshams la mnyam bzhag mdzad pa zhig g.yon nas de bzhin brtsis par yang re bzhi'i sa der phyag mdzub nam mkhar gtad pa zhig 'dug /de rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ ci lags zhus pas mnyam bzhag mdzad pa 'di ngas stong pa nyid phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i brda' yin/ phyag mdzub nam mkhar gtad pa 'di mi ring bar nga mkha' spyod du 'gro ba'i brda' yin gsungs/ rgya bod kyi mtshams 'dir smyon pa'i brtul zhugs can zhig sogs nga la sprul pa bdun 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ kun tu bzang po'i drung du phebs tshe tshogs 'khor mdzad/ nam mkha' la gar bsgyur nas 'byon pa mang du mdzad nas/ gnas 'di'ang bzang nga sngar dang mi 'dra bar kun tu bzang po'i thugs kar thim na'ang dbang che snyam pa zhig byung da nga'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin gsungs/ bco lnga la chos rje karma pa'i zla mchod mdzad/ kun tu bzang po la gser gsol/ 'phan chen zhig la chos rje'i sku dang*/ 'khor ba'i gnas la phyi phyag 'tshal ba'i bya bral pa des phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod/ ces sogs bris nas phul/

tshes bcu bdun gyi nub mo mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i mgur bzhengs/ zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang 'jam dbyangs seng ge la chibs pa kun tu bzang po glang chen la chibs pa bcas 'khor rnams la bstan pas mjal/ 'khor rnams kyis bla ma nges par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa bden nam ji lta bu lags zhus pas/ mkha' spyod du 'gro bya ba rnam smin gyi lus 'od lnga'i rang bzhin du grol te rdo rje'i skur 'gyur ba yin/ de 'dra bdag gis ga na 'ong*/ de 'dra byung na nga chos rje karma pa'i grwa pa 'bring tsam yin pas zhabs tog tu 'gyur/ bzang ngan 'brel thogs rnams la'ang de ga legs gsungs/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin grwa pa rnams la 'di ltar gyis kyi bkod pa mdzad/ ngom du zhal chems sku rtsed kyi rnam pa mang zhig bskur/ slob dpon pad+ma grub thob brgyad cus bskor ba gzigs/ byang sems srid pa tha ma par zhal gyis bzhes/ tshes bcu'i nub mo slob ma rnams la rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gnang zhing*/ sku'i bkod pa du ma bstan/ de nub gzim mal du pheb ste sgo 'phred gtan gyis bkag nas 'gyed gcad ma byed gsungs/ de nub grwa pa rnams la rmis ltas dang*/ mthong nyams sa g.yo ba dang*/ sgra 'od kyi ltas mang po byung bas the tshom du gyur te nang par drung bzhugs pa'i skar khung gi shog bu bkral nas bltas pas na bza' rnams rig pa tsam byung*/ de las cher bkral te bltas pas drung mi bzhugs par 'dug /de nas sgo phyungs te nang du song bas na bza' dbu zhwa/ sgom shing phyag phreng sogs 'phral chas rnams kyi steng du me tog gi char yam me ba zhig bab pa las gzhan ci'ang med do// de nas grwa pa rnams kyis ma se dgon du dgongs rdzogs kyi mang 'gyed btang ste/ der yang ltas ngo mtshar ba mang du byung*/ gzhan yang mdo dbus gtsang gsum du dgongs rdzogs rnams slob dpon sgam po pas phyag len dubatab nas bsgrub par mdzad/

rje 'dis dag ma dag gi skye ba mang po dran pa'i tshul gsungs shing*/ khyad par rgya gar du rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i sras tha chung du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang*/ o rgyan du rnal 'byor par gyur nas phag mos byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan du paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrīr gyur pa dang*/ rgya bal gyi mtshams su rnal 'byor pa ha du zhes bya bar gyur pa dang*/ dpal chen rga lo sogs kyi sngon tshul mang po dran zhing*/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pas kyang lung bstan par mdzad do/ /de ltar mkha' spyod pa'i rnam thar 'di ni bo dong pa'i slob ma khu ston bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa dang*/ sgam po pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar sogs las btus nas sbyar ba'o// ༈¿¿sgam po pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan ni/ mkha' spyod pa nyid khyim na bzhugs dus kyi sras te/ lo bcu gcig lon pa nas mkha' spyod pa nyid kyis drag po'i phrin las bsgrubs te/ dgra thams cad pham par byas dpa' ba'i grags pa thob/ nyer gnyis kyi bar du srid bskyangs nas khyim spangs te/ rab tu byung mkha' spyod pa nyid dang*/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma mang po bsten/ gnas nges med du bsgrub pa mdzad cing*/ sgam por yun ring du bzhugs pas sgam po par grags/ chos nyid kyi bden pa gzigs shing*/ rtsa rlung thig le la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po zhig go/ na mo ma hā sarba dz+nyādarasha dharmā ka rā ya/ mi nyag rtogs ldan blo gros rin chen ni/ gdung rigs mi nyag gi rgyal po tha'i hū la sogs pa'i gdung rigs kyi nang tshan rma se/ yab rma se rgya gar/ yum gling bzang bsod nams sgrol ma gnyis kyi sras su me stag lor karma'i sa cha gyam sher du sku 'khrungs/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa thog mar mjal bas 'jam dpal smra seng du gzigs/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan blo gros rin chen tu btag

/smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnang*/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi yab bka' dang yum bka'i dbang gnang dus bde mchog lhan skyes kyi rtsa gnas rnams su lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis kyi lus dkyil dang ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med bzhugs par gzigs/ grub chen brgyad dang skal ba mnyam pa'i tshogs 'khor mdzad/ bka' brgyud kyi chos 'khor thams cad dang khyad par karma snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thams cad chos bdag po'i tshul du bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gnang*/ yer pa rin po che gzhon nu sangs rgyas la rdzogs chen bi ma snying thig gi skor dang*/ sngags srung ma g.yu sbyang can zhus/ e ka dzā ṭis srog gi snying po phul zhing srung mar khas blang*/ skyes mchog yon tan rgyal mtshan la mkha' 'gro snying thig gi skor yang zhus shing gnam rtse lding du mkha' 'gro snying thig gi srung ma srog sgrub mched lngas srog snying phul/ dpal 'byor don grub la phyag bzhi pa dang dud sol ma zhus pas nag po lcam dral zhal yang yang gzigs/ sangs rgyas zhig chen lugs kyi bde mchog sogs kyi brgyud pa bzhugs na'ang*/ zur mang zhig chen phug du sangs rgyas zhig chen ye shes kyi sku dang mjal nas tshogs gar sogs gnang*/ rab sgang gi phag gdong ri dang*/ brag yer ba jo mo gangs dang*/ zur mang gi rdo zang phug sogs su sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas 'od gsal 'khor yug tu song*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gzigs rta mgrin nag pos rta skad sgrogs pa zhal gzigs/ srin po'i ri'i bde mchog gi sku bde mchog dngos su gzigs/ snyig thig gi nyams len mdzad skabs kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon pad+ma/ bi ma la mi tra sogs gzigs/ rtsa rlung las su rung zhig phyag rgya ma gcig bsten/ gzhan don rigs brgyud 'jog pa'i man ngag ltar sras nam mkha' sku 'khrungs/ slar yang dgung lo nyer lngar dbus su rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung du phebs nas bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/

rje karma pas lung bstan pa ltar 'bum rdzong du bzhugs skabs gle yos na yod pa'i 'ja' mo sogs kyis dgon gnas phul te bkris zur mang snar dgon pa mdzad/ sku gshegs dus sku gdung bzhugs pa'i du ba'i nang du grub chen nyid he ru ka'i cha byad 'khor rig ma rgyan can bzhi dang bcas pa slob ma rnams kyis mjal/ sras nam mkha'i skabs zur mang gnas drug gi mi sde rnams bdag gir mdzad cing lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las rgyas par gyur/ rje 'di yi slob ma'i tshogs shin tu mang na'ang skabs 'dir gleng bar 'os pa ni rtogs ldan ya brgyad dang 'ja' mo mi gsum rnams sogs te/ de las rtogs ldan ya brgyad ni/ dbon chos dpal ye shes/ rjis bsod nams ye shes/ mi nyag dkon mchog bzang po/ rtogs ldan bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ lha yag chos dpal rin chen/ bra bo kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ rtsa spyil bsod nams dpal grub/ chu gsol 'od zer bzang po dang brgyad rnams dang*/ 'ja' mo mi gsum ni bzhag shes rab bzang po/ rjis dgyes rdor ba/ chos sku 'od zer seng ge dang gsum mo/ /de rnams ni kar brgyud kyi chos dang gdam ngag spyi dang bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi bka' srol kho na 'dzin pa yin la/ sras nam mkha'i dbon po bya btang blo gros rgya mtshos dgongs 'dus pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan las rad gling gi chos skor rnams dang bla ma dgongs 'dus sogs gsan par mdzad/ bya btang ba'i sku'i skye phreng gnyis pa drung pa legs bshad pa ni/ mdo sngags spyi dang dbu ma gzhan stong skor la thugs mnyes pas mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan kyang dar bar gyur/ de nas bzung bstan 'dzin sprul sku na rim rnams dang*/ nang so pad+ma blo gros kyi sku skye karma rgyal sras rnam rgyal sogs nas rje si tu rin po che'i yongs 'dzin du gyur pa gar dbang chos skyong rnam rgyal gyi bar du+u byon pa'i gar dbang sprul sku na rim rnams dang*/

bra bo kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi skyes phreng la/ drung pa tsher lung pa dang*/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug gi yongs 'dzin du bzhes pa karma kun dga' rnam rgyal dang*/ 'jam mgon si tu rin po che'i yongs 'dzin bstan pa rnam rgyal gyi bar du byon pa rnams dang*/ rjis bsod nams ye shes kyi sprul brgyud las/ 'be bsod nams 'gyur med dang*/ tā'i si tu rin po che dang*/ dpal rig pa 'dzin pa chen po tshe dbang nor bu'i rigs bdag rje gsung rab rgya mtsho'i bar du byon pa rnams dang*/ rtsa spyil bsod nams dpal grub kyi skyes phreng ras chung karma dpal grub sogs ras chung pa'i skyes phreng rnams da lta'i bar du bzhugs shing*/ kam tshang bka' brgyud kyi zab chos spyi dang khyad par bde mchog snyan brgyud dang*/ gcod skor/ rad gling gi chos skor rnams dang dus phyis rig 'dzin rol ba rdo rje grags kyi gter byon gyi skor rnams kyi dbang lung nyams len gyi bka' ma chad par bzhugs pa'i zur mang bka' brgyud zhes pa 'di byung ngo*// 'dir smras pa/ 'dren pa mnyam med bu ram shing pa yis// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro rnams chos kyi sgo// grangs med bdud rtsi'i dga' ston sbyin mdzad nas// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la sbyor// der brten zab dang g.yo ba med pa'i dpal// rin chen 'byung gnas las 'ongs gangs can gyi// dge legs kar brgyud y-id bzhin dbang gi phreng*// thub bstan gsal ba'i rgyan du 'bar gyur cig/ ༈¿¿mi nyag rtogs ldan grags pa rin chen ni/ spyir grub pa brnyes pa sgyu lus dang rmi lam 'byongs pa ste/ mtshur phur gzim chung 'og tu mun mtshams la yod pa'i khang steng na chos rje rin po che bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mos gus kyi nyams 'bar nas sku mdun gyi zhal ba nas zang thal du thon pa dang*/ mtshur phu kung du brag phug zhig tu thugs dam la bzhugs tshe sgyu ma rang shar byung ste brag phug la zang thal byung nas ri de yi nub ngos gzhu'i nang de thad kyi phug pa zhig tu sgrub pa ba zhig yod pa phug pa'i sbug nas lus yer gyis thon byung bas sgrub pa ba de skrags nas bros skad/
